    have e2 : (p v).2 - (p w).2 = 0 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((p v).1 - (p w).1), sq_nonneg ((p v).2 - (p w).2)]
    ext <;> linarith
  · 
    apply hp.not_mem_line v w hvw
    have e : ((p v).1 + (p w).1) ^ 2 + ((p v).2 + (p w).2) ^ 2 = 0 := by nlinarith
    have e1 : (p v).1 + (p w).1 = 0 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((p v).1 + (p w).1), sq_nonneg ((p v).2 + (p w).2)]
    have e2 : (p v).2 + (p w).2 = 0 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((p v).1 + (p w).1), sq_nonneg ((p v).2 + (p w).2)]
    rw [mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq]
    refine ⟨1 / 2, ?_⟩
    rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply]
    ext <;> simp <;> linarith

name: FranklFuredi.not_mem_line_of_det_ne_zero
statement:
lemma not_mem_line_of_det_ne_zero {P Q : ℝ × ℝ} (hP : P.1 ^ 2 + P.2 ^ 2 = 1)
    (h : det2 P Q ≠ 0) : (0 : ℝ × ℝ) ∉ line[ℝ, P, Q]
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq]
  rintro ⟨r, hr⟩
  rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply] at hr
  have h1 : r * (Q.1 - P.1) + P.1 = 0 := by simpa using congrArg Prod.fst hr
  have h2 : r * (Q.2 - P.2) + P.2 = 0 := by simpa using congrArg Prod.snd hr
  
  have h3 : r * det2 P Q = 0 := by
    unfold det2
    have : P.1 * (r * (Q.2 - P.2) + P.2) - P.2 * (r * (Q.1 - P.1) + P.1) = 0 := by
      rw [h1, h2]; ring
    linarith
  have hr0 : r = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp h3).resolve_right h
  rw [hr0] at h1 h2
  simp at h1 h2
  rw [h1, h2] at hP
  norm_num at hP

name: FranklFuredi.isEdge_circleGraph_iff_cyc
statement:
lemma isEdge_circleGraph_iff_cyc {p : V → ℝ × ℝ} (hp : GenPos p) {a b c : V} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hac : a ≠ c) (hbc : b ≠ c) :
    (circleGraph p).IsEdge a b c ↔ Cyc (det2 (p a) (p b)) (det2 (p b) (p c)) (det2 (p c) (p a))
proof:
:= by
  rw [isEdge_circleGraph, det_criterion (hp a b hab) (hp b c hbc) (hp c a (Ne.symm hac))]
  simp [hab, hac, hbc]

name: FranklFuredi.lt_zero_iff_not_pos
statement: lemma lt_zero_iff_not_pos {x : ℝ} (h : x ≠ 0) : x < 0 ↔ ¬0 < x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx hx'; linarith
  · intro hx; rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne h with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd h hx

name: FranklFuredi.pos_mul_iff_of_ne
statement: lemma pos_mul_iff_of_ne {x y : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) : 0 < x * y ↔ (0 < x ↔ 0 < y)
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hx with hx | hx <;> rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hy with hy | hy
  · simp [mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg hx hy, not_lt.mpr hx.le, not_lt.mpr hy.le]
  · simp [hy, not_lt.mpr hx.le, not_lt.mpr (mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hx hy).le]
  · simp [hx, not_lt.mpr hy.le, not_lt.mpr (mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hx hy).le]
  · simp [mul_pos hx hy, hx, hy]

name: FranklFuredi.neg_mul_iff_of_ne
statement: lemma neg_mul_iff_of_ne {x y : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) : x * y < 0 ↔ ¬(0 < x ↔ 0 < y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pos_mul_iff_of_ne hx hy, lt_zero_iff_not_pos (mul_ne_zero hx hy)]

name: FranklFuredi.good4_of_dets
statement:
theorem good4_of_dets {x1 x2 x3 x4 x5 x6 : ℝ} (h1 : x1 ≠ 0) (h2 : x2 ≠ 0) (h3 : x3 ≠ 0)
    (h4 : x4 ≠ 0) (h5 : x5 ≠ 0) (h6 : x6 ≠ 0) (hpl : x1 * x6 - x2 * x5 + x3 * x4 = 0) :
    ((Cyc x1 x4 (-x2) ↔ Cyc x1 x5 (-x3)) ↔ (Cyc x2 x6 (-x3) ↔ Cyc x4 x6 (-x5))) ∧
      ¬(Cyc x1 x4 (-x2) ∧ Cyc x1 x5 (-x3) ∧ Cyc x2 x6 (-x3) ∧ Cyc x4 x6 (-x5))
proof:
:= by
  have C1 : ¬((0 < x1 ↔ 0 < x6) ∧ ¬(0 < x2 ↔ 0 < x5) ∧ (0 < x3 ↔ 0 < x4)) := by
    rintro ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
    have := (pos_mul_iff_of_ne h1 h6).mpr e1
    have := (neg_mul_iff_of_ne h2 h5).mpr e2
    have := (pos_mul_iff_of_ne h3 h4).mpr e3
    linarith
  have C2 : ¬(¬(0 < x1 ↔ 0 < x6) ∧ (0 < x2 ↔ 0 < x5) ∧ ¬(0 < x3 ↔ 0 < x4)) := by
    rintro ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
    have := (neg_mul_iff_of_ne h1 h6).mpr e1
    have := (pos_mul_iff_of_ne h2 h5).mpr e2
    have := (neg_mul_iff_of_ne h3 h4).mpr e3
    linarith
  simp only [Cyc, neg_pos, neg_lt_zero, lt_zero_iff_not_pos h1, lt_zero_iff_not_pos h2,
    lt_zero_iff_not_pos h3, lt_zero_iff_not_pos h4, lt_zero_iff_not_pos h5,
    lt_zero_iff_not_pos h6]
  by_cases p1 : 0 < x1 <;> by_cases p2 : 0 < x2 <;> by_cases p3 : 0 < x3 <;>
    by_cases p4 : 0 < x4 <;> by_cases p5 : 0 < x5 <;> by_cases p6 : 0 < x6 <;>
    simp [p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6] at C1 C2 ⊢

name: FranklFuredi.circleGraph_good
statement: theorem circleGraph_good {p : V → ℝ × ℝ} (hp : GenPos p) : Good (circleGraph p).IsEdge
proof:
:= by
  intro a b c d hab hac had hbc hbd hcd
  unfold Good4
  rw [isEdge_circleGraph_iff_cyc hp hab hac hbc, isEdge_circleGraph_iff_cyc hp hab had hbd,
    isEdge_circleGraph_iff_cyc hp hac had hcd, isEdge_circleGraph_iff_cyc hp hbc hbd hcd,
    det2_antisymm (p a) (p c), det2_antisymm (p a) (p d), det2_antisymm (p b) (p d)]
  exact good4_of_dets (hp a b hab) (hp a c hac) (hp a d had) (hp b c hbc) (hp b d hbd)
    (hp c d hcd) (plucker _ _ _ _)

name: FranklFuredi.circleGraph_fourPointProperty
statement:
theorem circleGraph_fourPointProperty {p : V → ℝ × ℝ} (hp : IsCircleConfig p) :
    (circleGraph p).FourPointProperty
proof:
:=
  ((circleGraph p).fourPointProperty_iff).mpr (circleGraph_good hp.genPos)

name: FranklFuredi.stereo_on_circle
statement: lemma stereo_on_circle (t : ℝ) : (stereo t).1 ^ 2 + (stereo t).2 ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have : (1 + t ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  simp only [stereo]
  field_simp
  ring

name: FranklFuredi.det2_stereo
statement:
lemma det2_stereo (s t : ℝ) :
    det2 (stereo s) (stereo t) = (t - s) * (1 + s * t) * (2 / ((1 + s ^ 2) * (1 + t ^ 2)))
proof:
:= by
  have hs : (1 + s ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have ht : (1 + t ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  simp only [det2, stereo]
  field_simp
  ring

name: FranklFuredi.det2_stereo_pos_iff
statement:
lemma det2_stereo_pos_iff (s t : ℝ) :
    0 < det2 (stereo s) (stereo t) ↔ 0 < (t - s) * (1 + s * t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [det2_stereo]
  have : 0 < 2 / ((1 + s ^ 2) * (1 + t ^ 2)) := by positivity
  exact mul_pos_iff_of_pos_right this

name: FranklFuredi.det2_stereo_neg_iff
statement:
lemma det2_stereo_neg_iff (s t : ℝ) :
    det2 (stereo s) (stereo t) < 0 ↔ (t - s) * (1 + s * t) < 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [det2_stereo]
  have : 0 < 2 / ((1 + s ^ 2) * (1 + t ^ 2)) := by positivity
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra h'
    push Not at h'
    have := mul_nonneg h' this.le
    linarith
  · intro h
    exact mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos h this

name: FranklFuredi.det2_stereo_ne_zero
statement:
lemma det2_stereo_ne_zero {s t : ℝ} (hst : s ≠ t) (h : 1 + s * t ≠ 0) :
    det2 (stereo s) (stereo t) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [det2_stereo]
  have : 0 < 2 / ((1 + s ^ 2) * (1 + t ^ 2)) := by positivity
  exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hst)) h) this.ne'

name: FranklFuredi.mem_nbhd
statement: @[simp] lemma mem_nbhd {w x : V} : x ∈ nbhd G w ↔ G w x
proof: := by simp [nbhd]

name: FranklFuredi.fin5_key
statement:
lemma fin5_key : ∀ T : Finset (Fin 5), (∀ i ∈ T, i + 1 ∉ T) → (∀ i ∈ T, i + 2 ∈ T ∨ i + 3 ∈ T) →
    T = ∅ ∨ ∃ j, T = {j - 1, j + 1}
proof: := by decide

name: FranklFuredi.fin5_uniq
statement: lemma fin5_uniq : ∀ j j' : Fin 5, ({j - 1, j + 1} : Finset (Fin 5)) = {j' - 1, j' + 1} → j = j'
proof:
:= by
  decide

name: FranklFuredi.fin5_inter
statement:
lemma fin5_inter : ∀ i j : Fin 5, ¬(j = i + 1 ∨ j = i - 1) →
    ∃ k, k ∈ ({i - 1, i + 1} : Finset (Fin 5)) ∧ k ∈ ({j - 1, j + 1} : Finset (Fin 5))
proof:
:= by
  decide

name: FranklFuredi.isC5Blowup_of_c5
statement:
theorem isC5Blowup_of_c5 (hG : TF2K2 G) (c : Fin 5 → V)
    (hc : ∀ i j, G (c i) (c j) ↔ (j = i + 1 ∨ j = i - 1)) : ∃ f, IsC5Blowup G f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S : V → Finset (Fin 5) := fun w => univ.filter (fun i => G w (c i))
  have mem_S : ∀ w i, i ∈ S w ↔ G w (c i) := fun w i => by simp [S]
  have hS1 : ∀ w, ∀ i ∈ S w, i + 1 ∉ S w := by
    intro w i hi hi1
    rw [mem_S] at hi hi1
    exact hG.triangle hi ((hc i (i + 1)).mpr (Or.inl rfl)) hi1
  have f1 : ∀ i : Fin 5, i + 3 = i + 2 + 1 := by decide
  have f2 : ∀ i : Fin 5, ¬(i + 2 = i + 1 ∨ i + 2 = i - 1) := by decide
  have f3 : ∀ i : Fin 5, ¬(i + 3 = i + 1 ∨ i + 3 = i - 1) := by decide
  have hS2 : ∀ w, ∀ i ∈ S w, i + 2 ∈ S w ∨ i + 3 ∈ S w := by
    intro w i hi
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    rw [mem_S] at hi
    rw [mem_S, mem_S] at h
    exact hG.twoK2 (a := w) (b := c i) (c := c (i + 2)) (d := c (i + 3)) hi
      ((hc _ _).mpr (Or.inl (f1 i))) h.1 h.2 (fun h' => f2 i ((hc _ _).mp h'))
      (fun h' => f3 i ((hc _ _).mp h'))
  have hS : ∀ w, S w = ∅ ∨ ∃ j, S w = {j - 1, j + 1} := fun w => fin5_key _ (hS1 w) (hS2 w)
  have g2 : ∀ j : Fin 5, j + 2 ∉ ({j - 1, j + 1} : Finset (Fin 5)) := by decide
  have g3 : ∀ j : Fin 5, j + 3 ∉ ({j - 1, j + 1} : Finset (Fin 5)) := by decide
  
  have hiso : ∀ w, S w = ∅ → ∀ z, ¬G w z := by
    intro w hw z hwz
    have hw' : ∀ i, ¬G w (c i) := fun i hi => by
      have : i ∈ S w := (mem_S w i).mpr hi
      rw [hw] at this
      simp at this
    rcases hS z with hz | ⟨j, hj⟩
    · have hz' : ∀ i, ¬G z (c i) := fun i hi => by
        have : i ∈ S z := (mem_S z i).mpr hi
        rw [hz] at this
        simp at this
      exact hG.twoK2 hwz ((hc 0 1).mpr (Or.inl rfl)) (hw' 0) (hw' 1) (hz' 0) (hz' 1)
    · have hz2 : ¬G z (c (j + 2)) := fun h => g2 j (hj ▸ (mem_S z _).mpr h)
      have hz3 : ¬G z (c (j + 3)) := fun h => g3 j (hj ▸ (mem_S z _).mpr h)
      exact hG.twoK2 hwz ((hc (j + 2) (j + 3)).mpr (Or.inl (f1 j))) (hw' _) (hw' _) hz2 hz3
  
  have h1 : ∀ i : Fin 5, i + 1 + 1 ∉ ({i - 1, i + 1} : Finset (Fin 5)) := by decide
  have h2 : ∀ i : Fin 5, i - 1 ∉ ({i + 1 - 1, i + 1 + 1} : Finset (Fin 5)) := by decide
  have h3 : ∀ i : Fin 5, ¬(i + 1 + 1 = i - 1 + 1 ∨ i + 1 + 1 = i - 1 - 1) := by decide
  have h4 : ∀ i : Fin 5, i - 1 - 1 ∉ ({i - 1, i + 1} : Finset (Fin 5)) := by decide
  have h5 : ∀ i : Fin 5, i + 1 ∉ ({i - 1 - 1, i - 1 + 1} : Finset (Fin 5)) := by decide
  have h6 : ∀ i : Fin 5, ¬(i - 1 - 1 = i + 1 + 1 ∨ i - 1 - 1 = i + 1 - 1) := by decide
  have hadj : ∀ w z i j, S w = {i - 1, i + 1} → S z = {j - 1, j + 1} →
      (G w z ↔ (j = i + 1 ∨ j = i - 1)) := by
    intro w z i j hw hz
    have hwc : ∀ k, G w (c k) ↔ k ∈ ({i - 1, i + 1} : Finset (Fin 5)) := fun k => by
      rw [← hw, mem_S]
    have hzc : ∀ k, G z (c k) ↔ k ∈ ({j - 1, j + 1} : Finset (Fin 5)) := fun k => by
      rw [← hz, mem_S]
    constructor
    · intro hwz
      by_contra hne
      obtain ⟨k, hk1, hk2⟩ := fin5_inter i j hne
      exact hG.triangle hwz ((hzc k).mpr hk2) ((hwc k).mpr hk1)
    · rintro (rfl | rfl)
      · by_contra hwz
        refine hG.twoK2 (a := w) (b := c (i - 1)) (c := z) (d := c (i + 1 + 1))
          ((hwc _).mpr (by simp)) ((hzc _).mpr (by simp)) hwz
          (fun h => ?_) (fun h => ?_) (fun h => ?_)
        · exact h1 i ((hwc _).mp h)
        · exact h2 i ((hzc _).mp (hG.symm h))
        · exact h3 i ((hc _ _).mp h)
      · by_contra hwz
        refine hG.twoK2 (a := w) (b := c (i + 1)) (c := z) (d := c (i - 1 - 1))
          ((hwc _).mpr (by simp)) ((hzc _).mpr (by simp)) hwz
          (fun h => ?_) (fun h => ?_) (fun h => ?_)
        · exact h4 i ((hwc _).mp h)
        · exact h5 i ((hzc _).mp (hG.symm h))
        · exact h6 i ((hc _ _).mp h)
  
  let f : V → Option (Fin 5) := fun w =>
    if h : ∃ j, S w = {j - 1, j + 1} then some h.choose else none
  have hf_some : ∀ w j, S w = {j - 1, j + 1} → f w = some j := by
    intro w j hj
    have h : ∃ j, S w = {j - 1, j + 1} := ⟨j, hj⟩
    simp only [f, dite_eq_left h, Option.some.injEq]
    exact fin5_uniq _ _ (h.choose_spec.symm.trans hj)
  have hf_none : ∀ w, S w = ∅ → f w = none := by
    intro w hw
    have h : ¬∃ j, S w = {j - 1, j + 1} := by
      rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
      rw [hw] at hj
      exact (insert_ne_empty _ _) hj.symm
    simp only [f, dite_eq_right h]
  refine ⟨f, fun a b => ?_⟩
  rcases hS a with ha | ⟨i, hi⟩
  · rw [hf_none a ha]
    simp only [reduceCtorEq, false_and, exists_false, iff_false]
    exact hiso a ha b
  rcases hS b with hb | ⟨j, hj⟩
  · rw [hf_none b hb]
    simp only [reduceCtorEq, or_self, and_false, exists_false, iff_false]
    exact fun h => hiso b hb a (hG.symm h)
  rw [hf_some a i hi, hf_some b j hj, hadj a b i j hi hj]
  simp

name: FranklFuredi.dichotomy
statement:
theorem dichotomy (hG : TF2K2 G) :
    (∃ f, IsC5Blowup G f) ∨ ∃ A B lev, IsChain G A B lev ∧ 5 ≤ (nonIsolated G).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hE : ∃ a b, G a b
  swap
  · push Not at hE
    exact Or.inl ⟨fun _ => none, fun a b => by simp [hE a b]⟩
  obtain ⟨a₀, b₀, h₀⟩ := hE
  obtain ⟨v, -, hv⟩ := exists_max_image univ (fun w => (nbhd G w).card) ⟨a₀, mem_univ _⟩
  have hv' : ∀ w, (nbhd G w).card ≤ (nbhd G v).card := fun w => hv w (mem_univ w)
  by_cases hR : ∃ x y, G x y ∧ ¬G v x ∧ ¬G v y
  · 
    left
    obtain ⟨x, y, hxy, hvx, hvy⟩ := hR
    have hA : ∀ a, G v a → G a x ∨ G a y := by
      intro a ha
      by_contra h
      push Not at h
      exact hG.twoK2 ha hxy hvx hvy h.1 h.2
    have hax : ∃ a, G v a ∧ G a x := by
      by_contra h
      push Not at h
      have hsub : insert x (nbhd G v) ⊆ nbhd G y := by
        intro z hz
        rw [mem_insert] at hz
        rw [mem_nbhd]
        rcases hz with rfl | hz
        · exact hG.symm hxy
        · rw [mem_nbhd] at hz
          exact hG.symm ((hA z hz).resolve_left (h z hz))
      have hxA : x ∉ nbhd G v := by rw [mem_nbhd]; exact hvx
      have h1 := card_le_card hsub
      rw [card_insert_of_notMem hxA] at h1
      have h2 := hv' y
      omega
    have hay : ∃ a, G v a ∧ G a y := by
      by_contra h
      push Not at h
      have hsub : insert y (nbhd G v) ⊆ nbhd G x := by
        intro z hz
        rw [mem_insert] at hz
        rw [mem_nbhd]
        rcases hz with rfl | hz
        · exact hxy
        · rw [mem_nbhd] at hz
          exact hG.symm ((hA z hz).resolve_right (h z hz))
      have hyA : y ∉ nbhd G v := by rw [mem_nbhd]; exact hvy
      have h1 := card_le_card hsub
      rw [card_insert_of_notMem hyA] at h1
      have h2 := hv' x
      omega
    obtain ⟨a, hva, hax⟩ := hax
    obtain ⟨a', hva', ha'y⟩ := hay
    have hay' : ¬G a y := fun h => hG.triangle hax hxy h
    have ha'x : ¬G a' x := fun h => hG.triangle h hxy ha'y
    have haa' : ¬G a a' := fun h => hG.triangle hva h hva'
    have s1 := hG.symm hva
    have s2 := hG.symm hax
    have s3 := hG.symm hxy
    have s4 := hG.symm ha'y
    have s5 := hG.symm hva'
    have t1 : ¬G x v := fun h => hvx (hG.symm h)
    have t2 : ¬G y v := fun h => hvy (hG.symm h)
    have t3 : ¬G y a := fun h => hay' (hG.symm h)
    have t4 : ¬G x a' := fun h => ha'x (hG.symm h)
    have t5 : ¬G a' a := fun h => haa' (hG.symm h)
    have i1 := hG.irrefl v
    have i2 := hG.irrefl a
    have i3 := hG.irrefl x
    have i4 := hG.irrefl y
    have i5 := hG.irrefl a'
    apply isC5Blowup_of_c5 hG ![v, a, x, y, a']
    intro i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
      simp +decide [hva, hax, hxy, ha'y, hva', hvx, hvy, hay', ha'x, haa', s1, s2, s3, s4, s5,
        t1, t2, t3, t4, t5, i1, i2, i3, i4, i5]
  · 
    push Not at hR
    set A := nbhd G v with hAdef
    have hedge : ∀ x y, G x y → x ∈ A ∨ y ∈ A := by
      intro x y hxy
      by_cases hx : G v x
      · exact Or.inl (mem_nbhd.mpr hx)
      · exact Or.inr (mem_nbhd.mpr (hR x y hxy hx))
    have hAind : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ a' ∈ A, ¬G a a' := by
      intro a ha a' ha' h
      rw [mem_nbhd] at ha ha'
      exact hG.triangle ha h ha'
    set B : Finset V := univ.filter (fun w => w ∉ A ∧ ∃ z, G w z) with hBdef
    have mem_B : ∀ w, w ∈ B ↔ w ∉ A ∧ ∃ z, G w z := fun w => by simp [hBdef]
    
    have hnest : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ a' ∈ A, nbhd G a ⊆ nbhd G a' ∨ nbhd G a' ⊆ nbhd G a := by
      intro a ha a' ha'
      by_contra h
      push Not at h
      obtain ⟨b, hb, hb'⟩ := not_subset.mp h.1
      obtain ⟨b', hb'1, hb'2⟩ := not_subset.mp h.2
      rw [mem_nbhd] at hb hb' hb'1 hb'2
      have hbA : b ∉ A := fun hbA => hAind a ha b hbA hb
      have hb'A : b' ∉ A := fun h' => hAind a' ha' b' h' hb'1
      have hbb' : ¬G b b' := fun h => by rcases hedge b b' h with h | h <;> contradiction
      exact hG.twoK2 hb hb'1 (hAind a ha a' ha') hb'2 (fun h => hb' (hG.symm h)) hbb'
    have hmono : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ a' ∈ A, (nbhd G a).card ≤ (nbhd G a').card →
        nbhd G a ⊆ nbhd G a' := by
      intro a ha a' ha' hle
      rcases hnest a ha a' ha' with h | h
      · exact h
      · exact (eq_of_subset_of_card_le h hle).ge
    
    let lev : V → ℕ := fun w => if w ∈ A then (nbhd G w).card else
      if h : (nbhd G w).Nonempty then
        ((nbhd G w).image (fun a => (nbhd G a).card)).min' (h.image _) else 0
    have hlevA : ∀ a ∈ A, lev a = (nbhd G a).card := fun a ha => by simp [lev, ha]
    have hlev_le : ∀ w ∉ A, ∀ a, G w a → lev w ≤ (nbhd G a).card := by
      intro w hw a hwa
      have hne : (nbhd G w).Nonempty := ⟨a, mem_nbhd.mpr hwa⟩
      simp only [lev, ite_eq_right hw, dite_eq_left hne]
      exact min'_le _ _ (mem_image_of_mem _ (mem_nbhd.mpr hwa))
    have hlev_mem : ∀ w ∉ A, (∃ z, G w z) → ∃ a, G w a ∧ (nbhd G a).card = lev w := by
      rintro w hw ⟨z, hwz⟩
      have hne : (nbhd G w).Nonempty := ⟨z, mem_nbhd.mpr hwz⟩
      have := min'_mem _ (hne.image (fun a => (nbhd G a).card))
      rw [mem_image] at this
      obtain ⟨a, ha, heq⟩ := this
      refine ⟨a, mem_nbhd.mp ha, ?_⟩
      simp only [lev, ite_eq_right hw, dite_eq_left hne]
      exact heq
    have hdisj : Disjoint A B := by
      rw [disjoint_left]
      intro w hwA hwB
      exact ((mem_B w).mp hwB).1 hwA
    have hchain : IsChain G A B lev := by
      refine ⟨hdisj, fun a b => ⟨fun hab => ?_, ?_⟩⟩
      · rcases hedge a b hab with haA | hbA
        · left
          have hbA : b ∉ A := fun hbA => hAind a haA b hbA hab
          refine ⟨haA, (mem_B b).mpr ⟨hbA, a, hG.symm hab⟩, ?_⟩
          rw [hlevA a haA]
          exact hlev_le b hbA a (hG.symm hab)
        · right
          have haA : a ∉ A := fun haA => hAind b hbA a haA (hG.symm hab)
          refine ⟨(mem_B a).mpr ⟨haA, b, hab⟩, hbA, ?_⟩
          rw [hlevA b hbA]
          exact hlev_le a haA b hab
      · rintro (⟨haA, hbB, hle⟩ | ⟨haB, hbA, hle⟩)
        · obtain ⟨hbA, hbn⟩ := (mem_B b).mp hbB
          obtain ⟨a₁, hba₁, heq⟩ := hlev_mem b hbA hbn
          have ha₁A : a₁ ∈ A := (hedge b a₁ hba₁).resolve_left hbA
          rw [hlevA a haA] at hle
          have hsub := hmono a₁ ha₁A a haA (by omega)
          exact mem_nbhd.mp (hsub (mem_nbhd.mpr (hG.symm hba₁)))
        · obtain ⟨haA, han⟩ := (mem_B a).mp haB
          obtain ⟨b₁, hab₁, heq⟩ := hlev_mem a haA han
          have hb₁A : b₁ ∈ A := (hedge a b₁ hab₁).resolve_left haA
          rw [hlevA b hbA] at hle
          have hsub := hmono b₁ hb₁A b hbA (by omega)
          exact hG.symm (mem_nbhd.mp (hsub (mem_nbhd.mpr (hG.symm hab₁))))
    
    have hvB : v ∈ B := by
      refine (mem_B v).mpr ⟨fun h => hG.irrefl v (mem_nbhd.mp h), ?_⟩
      have h1 : 0 < (nbhd G a₀).card := card_pos.mpr ⟨b₀, mem_nbhd.mpr h₀⟩
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := card_pos.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le h1 (hv' a₀))
      exact ⟨z, mem_nbhd.mp hz⟩
    have hvlev : ∀ a ∈ A, lev v ≤ lev a := by
      intro a ha
      have := (hchain.2 v a).mp (mem_nbhd.mp ha)
      rcases this with ⟨hvA, -, -⟩ | ⟨-, -, hle⟩
      · exact absurd hvA ((mem_B v).mp hvB).1
      · exact hle
    by_cases hcond : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, (∃ b' ∈ B, lev a < lev b') → (∃ a' ∈ A, lev a' < lev b) →
        lev a < lev b
    · 
      left
      let f : V → Option (Fin 5) := fun w =>
        if w ∈ A then (if ∀ b ∈ B, lev b ≤ lev w then some 2 else some 0)
        else if w ∈ B then (if ∀ a ∈ A, lev w ≤ lev a then some 1 else some 3) else none
      have hAB : ∀ w, w ∈ A → w ∉ B := fun w hw => disjoint_left.mp hdisj hw
      have hBA : ∀ w, w ∈ B → w ∉ A := fun w hw hwA => hAB w hwA hw
      have hfA : ∀ w ∈ A, f w = if ∀ b ∈ B, lev b ≤ lev w then some 2 else some 0 :=
        fun w hw => by simp only [f, hw, ↓reduceIte]
      have hfB : ∀ w ∈ B, f w = if ∀ a ∈ A, lev w ≤ lev a then some 1 else some 3 :=
        fun w hw => by simp only [f, hBA w hw, hw, ↓reduceIte]
      have hfN : ∀ w, w ∉ A → w ∉ B → f w = none :=
        fun w h1 h2 => by simp only [f, h1, h2, ↓reduceIte]
      refine ⟨f, fun a b => ?_⟩
      rw [hchain.2 a b]
      by_cases haA : a ∈ A
      · have haB := hAB a haA
        by_cases hbA : b ∈ A
        · have hbB := hAB b hbA
          rw [hfA a haA, hfA b hbA]
          by_cases h1 : ∀ b ∈ B, lev b ≤ lev a
          · rw [ite_eq_left h1]
            by_cases h2 : ∀ a ∈ B, lev a ≤ lev b
            · rw [ite_eq_left h2]; simp +decide [haB, hbB]
            · rw [ite_eq_right h2]; simp +decide [haB, hbB]
          · rw [ite_eq_right h1]
            by_cases h2 : ∀ a ∈ B, lev a ≤ lev b
            · rw [ite_eq_left h2]; simp +decide [haB, hbB]
            · rw [ite_eq_right h2]; simp +decide [haB, hbB]
        by_cases hbB : b ∈ B
        · rw [hfA a haA, hfB b hbB]
          by_cases hhi : ∀ b ∈ B, lev b ≤ lev a
          · have := hhi b hbB
            rw [ite_eq_left hhi]
            by_cases hlo : ∀ a ∈ A, lev b ≤ lev a
            · rw [ite_eq_left hlo]; simp +decide [haA, hbB, this]
            · rw [ite_eq_right hlo]; simp +decide [haA, hbB, this]
          · rw [ite_eq_right hhi]
            by_cases hlo : ∀ a ∈ A, lev b ≤ lev a
            · have := hlo a haA
              rw [ite_eq_left hlo]; simp +decide [haA, hbB, this]
            · rw [ite_eq_right hlo]
              have h' := hhi
              have h'' := hlo
              push Not at h' h''
              have := hcond a haA b hbB h' h''
              have hn : ¬ lev b ≤ lev a := by omega
              simp +decide [haB, hbA, hn]
        · rw [hfA a haA, hfN b hbA hbB]
          by_cases h1 : ∀ b ∈ B, lev b ≤ lev a
          · rw [ite_eq_left h1]; simp [hbA, hbB]
          · rw [ite_eq_right h1]; simp [hbA, hbB]
      by_cases haB : a ∈ B
      · by_cases hbA : b ∈ A
        · have hbB := hAB b hbA
          rw [hfB a haB, hfA b hbA]
          by_cases hhi : ∀ a ∈ B, lev a ≤ lev b
          · have := hhi a haB
            rw [ite_eq_left hhi]
            by_cases hlo : ∀ b ∈ A, lev a ≤ lev b
            · rw [ite_eq_left hlo]; simp +decide [haB, hbA, this]
            · rw [ite_eq_right hlo]; simp +decide [haB, hbA, this]
          · rw [ite_eq_right hhi]
            by_cases hlo : ∀ b ∈ A, lev a ≤ lev b
            · have := hlo b hbA
              rw [ite_eq_left hlo]; simp +decide [haB, hbA, this]
            · rw [ite_eq_right hlo]
              have h' := hhi
              have h'' := hlo
              push Not at h' h''
              have := hcond b hbA a haB h' h''
              have hn : ¬ lev a ≤ lev b := by omega
              simp +decide [haA, hbB, hn]
        by_cases hbB : b ∈ B
        · have hbA' := hBA b hbB
          rw [hfB a haB, hfB b hbB]
          by_cases h1 : ∀ b ∈ A, lev a ≤ lev b
          · rw [ite_eq_left h1]
            by_cases h2 : ∀ a ∈ A, lev b ≤ lev a
            · rw [ite_eq_left h2]; simp +decide [haA, hbA']
            · rw [ite_eq_right h2]; simp +decide [haA, hbA']
          · rw [ite_eq_right h1]
            by_cases h2 : ∀ a ∈ A, lev b ≤ lev a
            · rw [ite_eq_left h2]; simp +decide [haA, hbA']
            · rw [ite_eq_right h2]; simp +decide [haA, hbA']
        · rw [hfB a haB, hfN b hbA hbB]
          by_cases h1 : ∀ b ∈ A, lev a ≤ lev b
          · rw [ite_eq_left h1]; simp [hbA, hbB]
          · rw [ite_eq_right h1]; simp [hbA, hbB]
      · rw [hfN a haA haB]
        simp [haA, haB]
    · 
      right
      refine ⟨A, B, lev, hchain, ?_⟩
      push Not at hcond
      obtain ⟨a, haA, b, hbB, ⟨b', hb'B, hab'⟩, ⟨a', ha'A, ha'b⟩, hba⟩ := hcond
      have hva' := hvlev a' ha'A
      have hAB : ∀ w, w ∈ A → w ∉ B := fun w hw => disjoint_left.mp hdisj hw
      have n1 : a ≠ a' := by rintro rfl; omega
      have n2 : b ≠ b' := by rintro rfl; omega
      have n3 : b ≠ v := by rintro rfl; omega
      have n4 : b' ≠ v := by rintro rfl; omega
      have n5 : a ≠ b := fun h => hAB a haA (h ▸ hbB)
      have n6 : a ≠ b' := fun h => hAB a haA (h ▸ hb'B)
      have n7 : a ≠ v := fun h => hAB a haA (h ▸ hvB)
      have n8 : a' ≠ b := fun h => hAB a' ha'A (h ▸ hbB)
      have n9 : a' ≠ b' := fun h => hAB a' ha'A (h ▸ hb'B)
      have n10 : a' ≠ v := fun h => hAB a' ha'A (h ▸ hvB)
      have hsub : ({a, a', b, b', v} : Finset V) ⊆ nonIsolated G := by
        intro w hw
        simp only [mem_insert, mem_singleton] at hw
        simp only [nonIsolated, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
        rcases hw with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
        · exact ⟨v, hG.symm (mem_nbhd.mp haA)⟩
        · exact ⟨v, hG.symm (mem_nbhd.mp ha'A)⟩
        · exact ((mem_B _).mp hbB).2
        · exact ((mem_B _).mp hb'B).2
        · exact ((mem_B _).mp hvB).2
      have hcard : ({a, a', b, b', v} : Finset V).card = 5 := by
        rw [card_insert_of_notMem (by simp [n1, n5, n6, n7]),
          card_insert_of_notMem (by simp [n8, n9, n10]),
          card_insert_of_notMem (by simp [n2, n3]), card_pair n4]
      exact hcard ▸ card_le_card hsub

name: ProjectionConstants.rowSumNorm_nonneg
statement: lemma rowSumNorm_nonneg (P : Matrix m n 𝕜) : 0 ≤ rowSumNorm P
proof: := NNReal.coe_nonneg _

name: ProjectionConstants.row_le_rowSumNorm
statement: lemma row_le_rowSumNorm (P : Matrix m n 𝕜) (i : m) : ∑ j, ‖P i j‖ ≤ rowSumNorm P
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∑ j, ‖P i j‖₊ ≤ Finset.univ.sup fun i => ∑ j, ‖P i j‖₊ :=
    Finset.le_sup (f := fun i => ∑ j, ‖P i j‖₊) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have h' := NNReal.coe_le_coe.2 h
  simpa [rowSumNorm] using h'

name: ProjectionConstants.rowSumNorm_le
statement:
lemma rowSumNorm_le {P : Matrix m n 𝕜} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (h : ∀ i, ∑ j, ‖P i j‖ ≤ c) :
    rowSumNorm P ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  rw [rowSumNorm, ← NNReal.coe_mk c hc, NNReal.coe_le_coe]
  refine Finset.sup_le fun i _ => ?_
  rw [← NNReal.coe_le_coe]
  simpa using h i

name: ProjectionConstants.exists_row_eq_rowSumNorm
statement:
lemma exists_row_eq_rowSumNorm [Nonempty m] (P : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    ∃ i, ∑ j, ‖P i j‖ = rowSumNorm P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, -, hi⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup (Finset.univ : Finset m) Finset.univ_nonempty
    (fun i => ∑ j, ‖P i j‖₊)
  refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
  simp only [rowSumNorm, hi, NNReal.coe_sum, coe_nnnorm]

name: ProjectionConstants.rowSumNorm_eq_opNorm
statement:
theorem rowSumNorm_eq_opNorm [DecidableEq n] (P : Matrix m n 𝕜) :
    rowSumNorm P = ‖LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (Matrix.toLin' P)‖
proof:
:= by
  have h := Matrix.linfty_opNorm_toMatrix (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (Matrix.toLin' P))
  rw [← h, Matrix.linfty_opNorm_def]
  simp [rowSumNorm]

name: ProjectionConstants.IsMatrixProjOnto.toCLM
statement:
lemma IsMatrixProjOnto.toCLM {P : Matrix ι ι 𝕜} (hP : IsMatrixProjOnto Y P) :
    IsProjectionOnto Y (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (Matrix.toLin' P))
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun x => by simpa using hP.mem x, fun y hy => by simpa using hP.map_id y hy⟩

name: ProjectionConstants.toContinuousLinearMap_coe
statement:
lemma toContinuousLinearMap_coe (f : (ι → 𝕜) →L[𝕜] (ι → 𝕜)) :
    LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (f : (ι → 𝕜) →ₗ[𝕜] (ι → 𝕜)) = f
proof:
:=
  (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap_eq_iff_eq_toLinearMap _ _).2 rfl

name: ProjectionConstants.isMatrixProjOnto_toMatrix
statement:
lemma isMatrixProjOnto_toMatrix {f : (ι → 𝕜) →L[𝕜] (ι → 𝕜)} (hf : IsProjectionOnto Y f) :
    IsMatrixProjOnto Y (LinearMap.toMatrix' (f : (ι → 𝕜) →ₗ[𝕜] (ι → 𝕜)))
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun x => by simpa [Matrix.toLin'_toMatrix'] using hf.mem x,
    fun y hy => by simpa [Matrix.toLin'_toMatrix'] using hf.map_id y hy⟩

name: ProjectionConstants.relProjConst_le_rowSumNorm
statement:
lemma relProjConst_le_rowSumNorm {P : Matrix ι ι 𝕜} (hP : IsMatrixProjOnto Y P) :
    relProjConst Y ≤ rowSumNorm P
proof:
:= by
  rw [rowSumNorm_eq_opNorm]
  exact relProjConst_le Y (hP.toCLM Y)

name: ProjectionConstants.le_relProjConst_of_rowSumNorm
proof:
:= by
  refine le_relProjConst Y fun f hf => ?_
  have h1 := h _ (isMatrixProjOnto_toMatrix Y hf)
  rwa [rowSumNorm_eq_opNorm, Matrix.toLin'_toMatrix', toContinuousLinearMap_coe] at h1

name: ProjectionConstants.exists_isMatrixProjOnto_lt
statement:
lemma exists_isMatrixProjOnto_lt {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ P : Matrix ι ι 𝕜, IsMatrixProjOnto Y P ∧ rowSumNorm P < relProjConst Y + ε
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hlt⟩ := exists_isProjectionOnto_norm_lt Y hε
  refine ⟨_, isMatrixProjOnto_toMatrix Y hf, ?_⟩
  rwa [rowSumNorm_eq_opNorm, Matrix.toLin'_toMatrix', toContinuousLinearMap_coe]

name: ProjectionConstants.exists_isMatrixProjOnto
statement: lemma exists_isMatrixProjOnto : ∃ P : Matrix ι ι 𝕜, IsMatrixProjOnto Y P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP, -⟩ := exists_isMatrixProjOnto_lt Y one_pos
  exact ⟨P, hP⟩

name: ProjectionConstants.rk1_conjTranspose
statement: lemma rk1_conjTranspose (x : ι → 𝕜) : (rk1 x)ᴴ = rk1 x
proof:
:= by
  simp [rk1, conjTranspose_vecMulVec]

name: ProjectionConstants.mul_rk1
statement: lemma mul_rk1 (M : Matrix ι ι 𝕜) (x : ι → 𝕜) : M * rk1 x = vecMulVec (M *ᵥ x) (star x)
proof:
:=
  mul_vecMulVec _ _ _

name: ProjectionConstants.rk1_mul_of_herm
statement:
lemma rk1_mul_of_herm {M : Matrix ι ι 𝕜} (hM : Mᴴ = M) (x : ι → 𝕜) :
    rk1 x * M = vecMulVec x (star (M *ᵥ x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [rk1, vecMulVec_mul, star_mulVec, hM]

name: ProjectionConstants.rk1_mul_rk1
statement: lemma rk1_mul_rk1 (x y : ι → 𝕜) : rk1 x * rk1 y = (star x ⬝ᵥ y) • vecMulVec x (star y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rk1, rk1, vecMulVec_mul_vecMulVec]
  ext i j
  simp [vecMulVec_apply, mul_left_comm]

name: ProjectionConstants.trace_mul_rk1
statement:
lemma trace_mul_rk1 (A : Matrix ι ι 𝕜) (x : ι → 𝕜) :
    (A * rk1 x).trace = star x ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_rk1, trace_vecMulVec, dotProduct_comm]

name: ProjectionConstants.trace_rk1
statement: lemma trace_rk1 (x : ι → 𝕜) : (rk1 x).trace = star x ⬝ᵥ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [rk1, trace_vecMulVec, dotProduct_comm]

name: ProjectionConstants.isOrthProj_rk1
statement: lemma isOrthProj_rk1 {v : ι → 𝕜} (hv : star v ⬝ᵥ v = 1) : IsOrthProj (rk1 v)
proof:
:=
  ⟨rk1_conjTranspose v, by rw [rk1_mul_rk1, hv, one_smul]; rfl⟩

name: ProjectionConstants.isOrthProj_sub_rk1
statement:
lemma isOrthProj_sub_rk1 {Q : Matrix ι ι 𝕜} (hQ : IsOrthProj Q) {x : ι → 𝕜} (hx : Q *ᵥ x = x)
    (hxx : star x ⬝ᵥ x = 1) : IsOrthProj (Q - rk1 x)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨by rw [conjTranspose_sub, hQ.herm, rk1_conjTranspose], ?_⟩
  have h1 : Q * rk1 x = rk1 x := by rw [mul_rk1, hx]; rfl
  have h2 : rk1 x * Q = rk1 x := by rw [rk1_mul_of_herm hQ.herm, hx]; rfl
  have h3 : rk1 x * rk1 x = rk1 x := by rw [rk1_mul_rk1, hxx, one_smul]; rfl
  rw [sub_mul, mul_sub, mul_sub, hQ.idem, h1, h2, h3]
  abel

name: ProjectionConstants.IsOrthProj.add
statement:
lemma IsOrthProj.add {E F : Matrix ι ι 𝕜} (hE : IsOrthProj E) (hF : IsOrthProj F)
    (hEF : E * F = 0) : IsOrthProj (E + F)
proof:
:= by
  have hFE : F * E = 0 := by
    have := congrArg conjTranspose hEF
    rwa [conjTranspose_mul, hE.herm, hF.herm, conjTranspose_zero] at this
  refine ⟨by rw [conjTranspose_add, hE.herm, hF.herm], ?_⟩
  rw [add_mul, mul_add, mul_add, hE.idem, hF.idem, hEF, hFE]
  abel

name: ProjectionConstants.dotProduct_mulVec_star
statement:
lemma dotProduct_mulVec_star (M : Matrix ι ι 𝕜) (u v : ι → 𝕜) :
    star u ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ v) = star (Mᴴ *ᵥ u) ⬝ᵥ v
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotProduct_mulVec, star_mulVec, conjTranspose_conjTranspose]

name: ProjectionConstants.dotProduct_mulVec_herm
statement:
lemma dotProduct_mulVec_herm {A : Matrix ι ι 𝕜} (hA : Aᴴ = A) (x y : ι → 𝕜) :
    star x ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ y) = star (star y ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotProduct_mulVec_star, hA, star_dotProduct]

name: ProjectionConstants.re_dotProduct_mulVec_herm
statement:
lemma re_dotProduct_mulVec_herm {A : Matrix ι ι 𝕜} (hA : Aᴴ = A) (x y : ι → 𝕜) :
    RCLike.re (star x ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ y)) = RCLike.re (star y ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotProduct_mulVec_herm hA, RCLike.star_def, RCLike.conj_re]

name: ProjectionConstants.re_quad_add
statement:
lemma re_quad_add {A : Matrix ι ι 𝕜} (hA : Aᴴ = A) (x y : ι → 𝕜) (c d : ℝ) :
    RCLike.re (star ((c : 𝕜) • x + (d : 𝕜) • y) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ ((c : 𝕜) • x + (d : 𝕜) • y))) =
      c ^ 2 * RCLike.re (star x ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)) +
        2 * c * d * RCLike.re (star y ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)) +
        d ^ 2 * RCLike.re (star y ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ y))
proof:
:= by
  have hxy := re_dotProduct_mulVec_herm hA x y
  simp only [star_add, star_smul, RCLike.star_def, RCLike.conj_ofReal, mulVec_add,
    mulVec_smul, add_dotProduct, dotProduct_add, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul,
    smul_eq_mul, map_add, RCLike.re_ofReal_mul]
  rw [hxy]
  ring

name: ProjectionConstants.dotProduct_add_smul
statement:
lemma dotProduct_add_smul (x y : ι → 𝕜) (c d : ℝ) :
    star ((c : 𝕜) • x + (d : 𝕜) • y) ⬝ᵥ ((c : 𝕜) • x + (d : 𝕜) • y) =
      (c ^ 2 : ℝ) * (star x ⬝ᵥ x) + (c * d : ℝ) * (star x ⬝ᵥ y + star y ⬝ᵥ x) +
        (d ^ 2 : ℝ) * (star y ⬝ᵥ y)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [star_add, star_smul, RCLike.star_def, RCLike.conj_ofReal, add_dotProduct,
    dotProduct_add, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  push_cast
  ring

name: ProjectionConstants.exists_normalize
statement:
lemma exists_normalize {v : ι → 𝕜} (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ star ((c : 𝕜) • v) ⬝ᵥ ((c : 𝕜) • v) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < RCLike.re (star v ⬝ᵥ v) := by
    have h1 : star v ⬝ᵥ v = ((∑ i, ‖v i‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜) := by
      simp only [dotProduct, Pi.star_apply, RCLike.star_def, RCLike.conj_mul]
      push_cast; rfl
    rw [h1, RCLike.ofReal_re]
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Function.ne_iff.1 hv
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (pow_pos (norm_pos_iff.2 hi) 2)
      (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => ‖v i‖ ^ 2) (fun _ _ => by positivity)
        (Finset.mem_univ i))
  have hre : star v ⬝ᵥ v = (RCLike.re (star v ⬝ᵥ v) : 𝕜) := by
    simp only [dotProduct, Pi.star_apply, RCLike.star_def, RCLike.conj_mul, map_sum]
    simp
  refine ⟨1 / √(RCLike.re (star v ⬝ᵥ v)), by positivity, ?_⟩
  simp only [star_smul, RCLike.star_def, RCLike.conj_ofReal, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul,
    smul_eq_mul]
  rw [hre, ← mul_assoc]
  norm_cast
  field_simp
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt hpos.le]

name: ProjectionConstants.exists_rotation_gt
statement:
theorem exists_rotation_gt {m : ℕ} {A Q : Matrix ι ι 𝕜} (hA : Aᴴ = A)
    (hQ : Q ∈ orthProjs 𝕜 ι m) {x y : ι → 𝕜} (hQx : Q *ᵥ x = x) (hQy : Q *ᵥ y = 0)
    (hxx : star x ⬝ᵥ x = 1) (hyy : star y ⬝ᵥ y = 1) (hxy : star x ⬝ᵥ y = 0)
    (hβ : 0 < RCLike.re (star y ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x))) :
    ∃ Q' ∈ orthProjs 𝕜 ι m, RCLike.re (A * Q).trace < RCLike.re (A * Q').trace
proof:
:= by
  have hyx : star y ⬝ᵥ x = 0 := by rw [star_dotProduct, hxy, star_zero]
  set a := RCLike.re (star x ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x))
  set b := RCLike.re (star y ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ y))
  set β := RCLike.re (star y ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x))
  set s : ℝ := min (1 / 2) (β / (2 * (|b - a| + 1))) with hs_def
  have hs0 : 0 < s := lt_min (by norm_num) (by positivity)
  have hs1 : s ≤ 1 / 2 := min_le_left _ _
  have hs2 : s * |b - a| ≤ β / 2 := by
    have h := min_le_right (1 / 2 : ℝ) (β / (2 * (|b - a| + 1)))
    rw [← hs_def] at h
    calc s * |b - a| ≤ β / (2 * (|b - a| + 1)) * |b - a| :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h (abs_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ β / (2 * (|b - a| + 1)) * (|b - a| + 1) := by
          gcongr; linarith
      _ = β / 2 := by field_simp
  set c : ℝ := (1 - s ^ 2) / (1 + s ^ 2) with hc_def
  set d : ℝ := 2 * s / (1 + s ^ 2) with hd_def
  have hsq : 0 < 1 + s ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hcd : c ^ 2 + d ^ 2 = 1 := by
    rw [hc_def, hd_def]
    field_simp
    ring
  set v := (c : 𝕜) • x + (d : 𝕜) • y with hv_def
  have hvv : star v ⬝ᵥ v = 1 := by
    rw [hv_def, dotProduct_add_smul, hxx, hyy, hxy, hyx]
    simp only [add_zero, mul_one, mul_zero]
    exact_mod_cast hcd
  
  have hE : IsOrthProj (Q - rk1 x) := isOrthProj_sub_rk1 hQ.1 hQx hxx
  have hEv : (Q - rk1 x) *ᵥ v = 0 := by
    rw [sub_mulVec, rk1, vecMulVec_mulVec, hv_def, mulVec_add, mulVec_smul,
      mulVec_smul, hQx, hQy, dotProduct_add, dotProduct_smul, dotProduct_smul, hxx, hxy]
    ext i
    simp
  have hQ' : (Q - rk1 x) + rk1 v ∈ orthProjs 𝕜 ι m := by
    refine ⟨hE.add (isOrthProj_rk1 hvv) (by rw [mul_rk1, hEv, zero_vecMulVec]), ?_⟩
    rw [trace_add, trace_sub, trace_rk1, trace_rk1, hxx, hvv, hQ.2]
    ring
  refine ⟨_, hQ', ?_⟩
  have hval : RCLike.re (A * ((Q - rk1 x) + rk1 v)).trace =
      RCLike.re (A * Q).trace - a + (c ^ 2 * a + 2 * c * d * β + d ^ 2 * b) := by
    rw [mul_add, mul_sub, trace_add, trace_sub, trace_mul_rk1, trace_mul_rk1,
      map_add, map_sub, hv_def, re_quad_add hA]
  rw [hval]
  have hc2 : c ^ 2 = 1 - d ^ 2 := by linarith
  have hd0 : 0 < d := by rw [hd_def]; positivity
  have hinner : 0 < d * (b - a) + 2 * c * β := by
    have hba : -(s * |b - a|) ≤ s * (b - a) := by
      have h1 := neg_abs_le (b - a)
      nlinarith
    have h34 : (3 : ℝ) / 4 ≤ 1 - s ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have e : d * (b - a) + 2 * c * β = (2 * (s * (b - a)) + 2 * ((1 - s ^ 2) * β)) / (1 + s ^ 2) := by
      rw [hc_def, hd_def]
      field_simp
    rw [e]
    apply div_pos _ hsq
    nlinarith
  have : 0 < c ^ 2 * a + 2 * c * d * β + d ^ 2 * b - a := by
    have e : c ^ 2 * a + 2 * c * d * β + d ^ 2 * b - a = d * (d * (b - a) + 2 * c * β) := by
      rw [hc2]; ring
    rw [e]
    exact mul_pos hd0 hinner
  linarith

name: ProjectionConstants.commute_of_isMaxOn
statement:
theorem commute_of_isMaxOn {m : ℕ} {A Q : Matrix ι ι 𝕜} (hA : Aᴴ = A)
    (hQ : Q ∈ orthProjs 𝕜 ι m)
    (hmax : ∀ Q' ∈ orthProjs 𝕜 ι m, RCLike.re (A * Q').trace ≤ RCLike.re (A * Q).trace) :
    A * Q = Q * A
proof:
:= by
  have hQh := hQ.1.herm
  have hQi := hQ.1.idem
  
  have hRh : (1 - Q)ᴴ = 1 - Q := by rw [conjTranspose_sub, conjTranspose_one, hQh]
  have hQR : Q * (1 - Q) = 0 := by rw [mul_sub, mul_one, hQi, sub_self]
  have hRR : (1 - Q) * (1 - Q) = 1 - Q := by
    rw [sub_mul, one_mul, hQR, sub_zero]
  have key : (1 - Q) * A * Q = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ : ∃ z, ((1 - Q) * A * Q) *ᵥ z ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra! h
      refine hne (Matrix.toLin'.injective (LinearMap.ext fun z => ?_))
      simp only [Matrix.toLin'_apply, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
      exact h z
    
    have hx0 : Q *ᵥ z ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hz
      rw [← mulVec_mulVec, h0, mulVec_zero]
    obtain ⟨c₀, hc₀, hxx⟩ := exists_normalize hx0
    set x := (c₀ : 𝕜) • (Q *ᵥ z) with hx_def
    have hQx : Q *ᵥ x = x := by rw [hx_def, mulVec_smul, mulVec_mulVec, hQi]
    
    set y₀ := (1 - Q) *ᵥ (A *ᵥ x) with hy₀_def
    have hy₀ : y₀ ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hy₀_def, hx_def, mulVec_smul, mulVec_smul, mulVec_mulVec, mulVec_mulVec]
      exact smul_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast hc₀.ne') hz
    obtain ⟨c₁, hc₁, hyy⟩ := exists_normalize hy₀
    set y := (c₁ : 𝕜) • y₀ with hy_def
    have hQy : Q *ᵥ y = 0 := by
      rw [hy_def, hy₀_def, mulVec_smul, mulVec_mulVec, hQR, zero_mulVec, smul_zero]
    have hxy : star x ⬝ᵥ y = 0 := by
      rw [hy_def, hy₀_def, dotProduct_smul, dotProduct_mulVec_star, hRh]
      have : (1 - Q) *ᵥ x = 0 := by rw [sub_mulVec, one_mulVec, hQx, sub_self]
      rw [this, star_zero, zero_dotProduct, smul_zero]
    
    have hβ : 0 < RCLike.re (star y ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)) := by
      have e1 : star y₀ ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x) = star y₀ ⬝ᵥ y₀ := by
        rw [hy₀_def]
        symm
        rw [dotProduct_mulVec_star (1 - Q) ((1 - Q) *ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)) (A *ᵥ x), hRh, mulVec_mulVec,
          hRR]
      have e2 : star y ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x) = (c₁ : 𝕜) * (star y₀ ⬝ᵥ y₀) := by
        rw [hy_def, star_smul, RCLike.star_def, RCLike.conj_ofReal, smul_dotProduct, e1,
          smul_eq_mul]
      have e3 : star y ⬝ᵥ y = (c₁ : 𝕜) ^ 2 * (star y₀ ⬝ᵥ y₀) := by
        rw [hy_def, star_smul, RCLike.star_def, RCLike.conj_ofReal, smul_dotProduct,
          dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
        ring
      have e4 : RCLike.re (star y₀ ⬝ᵥ y₀) = 1 / c₁ ^ 2 := by
        have := congrArg RCLike.re (e3.symm.trans hyy)
        rw [RCLike.one_re] at this
        have h' : RCLike.re ((c₁ : 𝕜) ^ 2 * (star y₀ ⬝ᵥ y₀)) =
            c₁ ^ 2 * RCLike.re (star y₀ ⬝ᵥ y₀) := by
          rw [← RCLike.ofReal_pow, RCLike.re_ofReal_mul]
        rw [h'] at this
        field_simp
        linarith
      rw [e2, RCLike.re_ofReal_mul, e4]
      positivity
    clear_value x y y₀
    obtain ⟨Q', hQ', hlt⟩ := exists_rotation_gt hA hQ hQx hQy hxx hyy hxy hβ
    exact absurd (hmax Q' hQ') (not_le.2 hlt)
  
  have h1 : A * Q = Q * A * Q := by
    have : A * Q - Q * A * Q = 0 := by
      rw [← key, sub_mul, sub_mul, one_mul]
    exact sub_eq_zero.1 this
  have h2 : Q * A = Q * A * Q := by
    have := congrArg conjTranspose h1
    simp only [conjTranspose_mul, hA, hQh] at this
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    exact this
  rw [h1, ← h2]

name: ProjectionConstants.IsOrthProj.apply_symm
statement: lemma apply_symm (i j : ι) : P j i = star (P i j)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← hP.herm]
  rfl

name: ProjectionConstants.IsOrthProj.norm_apply_symm
statement: lemma norm_apply_symm (i j : ι) : ‖P j i‖ = ‖P i j‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [hP.apply_symm, norm_star]

name: ProjectionConstants.IsOrthProj.conjTranspose_mul_self
statement: lemma conjTranspose_mul_self : Pᴴ * P = P
proof: := by rw [hP.herm, hP.idem]

name: ProjectionConstants.IsOrthProj.diag_eq
statement: lemma diag_eq (i : ι) : P i i = ((∑ k, ‖P k i‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : 𝕜)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← hP.conjTranspose_mul_self]
  simp only [mul_apply, conjTranspose_apply, RCLike.star_def, RCLike.conj_mul]
  push_cast
  rfl

name: ProjectionConstants.IsOrthProj.re_diag
statement: lemma re_diag (i : ι) : RCLike.re (P i i) = ∑ k, ‖P k i‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [hP.diag_eq i, RCLike.ofReal_re]

name: ProjectionConstants.IsOrthProj.diag_eq_re
statement: lemma diag_eq_re (i : ι) : P i i = (RCLike.re (P i i) : 𝕜)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hP.re_diag, hP.diag_eq]

name: ProjectionConstants.IsOrthProj.re_diag_eq_sum_row
statement: lemma re_diag_eq_sum_row (i : ι) : RCLike.re (P i i) = ∑ k, ‖P i k‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [hP.re_diag]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => by rw [hP.norm_apply_symm]

name: ProjectionConstants.IsOrthProj.re_diag_nonneg
statement: lemma re_diag_nonneg (i : ι) : 0 ≤ RCLike.re (P i i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hP.re_diag]
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => by positivity

name: ProjectionConstants.IsOrthProj.norm_apply_sq_le
statement: lemma norm_apply_sq_le (i j : ι) : ‖P i j‖ ^ 2 ≤ RCLike.re (P j j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hP.re_diag]
  exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k => ‖P k j‖ ^ 2) (fun k _ => by positivity)
    (Finset.mem_univ i)

name: ProjectionConstants.IsOrthProj.norm_diag_eq
statement: lemma norm_diag_eq (i : ι) : ‖P i i‖ = RCLike.re (P i i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hP.diag_eq_re i, RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_of_nonneg (by simpa using hP.re_diag_nonneg i)]
  simp

name: ProjectionConstants.IsOrthProj.re_diag_le_one
statement: lemma re_diag_le_one (i : ι) : RCLike.re (P i i) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := hP.norm_apply_sq_le i i
  rw [hP.norm_diag_eq] at h
  nlinarith [hP.re_diag_nonneg i]

name: ProjectionConstants.IsOrthProj.norm_apply_le_one
statement: lemma norm_apply_le_one (i j : ι) : ‖P i j‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := (hP.norm_apply_sq_le i j).trans (hP.re_diag_le_one j)
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (P i j)]

name: ProjectionConstants.IsOrthProj.norm_apply_sq_le_mul
statement:
lemma norm_apply_sq_le_mul (i j : ι) :
    ‖P i j‖ ^ 2 ≤ RCLike.re (P i i) * RCLike.re (P j j)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hij : P i j = ∑ k, star (P k i) * P k j := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← hP.conjTranspose_mul_self]
    simp [mul_apply]
  have h1 : ‖P i j‖ ≤ ∑ k, ‖P k i‖ * ‖P k j‖ := by
    rw [hij]
    refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    simp
  have h2 : (∑ k, ‖P k i‖ * ‖P k j‖) ^ 2 ≤ (∑ k, ‖P k i‖ ^ 2) * ∑ k, ‖P k j‖ ^ 2 :=
    Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq _ _ _
  rw [hP.re_diag, hP.re_diag]
  calc ‖P i j‖ ^ 2 ≤ (∑ k, ‖P k i‖ * ‖P k j‖) ^ 2 := by gcongr
    _ ≤ _ := h2

name: ProjectionConstants.finrank_range_eq_trace
statement:
theorem finrank_range_eq_trace {P : Matrix ι ι 𝕜} (hP : P * P = P) :
    (Module.finrank 𝕜 (LinearMap.range (Matrix.toLin' P)) : 𝕜) = P.trace
proof:
:= by
  have hid : IsIdempotentElem (Matrix.toLin' P) := by
    show Matrix.toLin' P * Matrix.toLin' P = Matrix.toLin' P
    rw [Module.End.mul_eq_comp, ← Matrix.toLin'_mul, hP]
  rw [← Matrix.trace_toLin'_eq P,
    ((LinearMap.isProj_range_iff_isIdempotentElem _).mpr hid).trace]

name: ProjectionConstants.finrank_range_of_mem_orthProjs
statement:
lemma finrank_range_of_mem_orthProjs {m : ℕ} {P : Matrix ι ι 𝕜} (hP : P ∈ orthProjs 𝕜 ι m) :
    Module.finrank 𝕜 (LinearMap.range (Matrix.toLin' P)) = m
proof:
:= by
  have h := finrank_range_eq_trace hP.1.idem
  rw [hP.2] at h
  exact_mod_cast h

name: ProjectionConstants.isMatrixProjOnto_range
statement:
lemma isMatrixProjOnto_range {P : Matrix ι ι 𝕜} (hP : P * P = P) :
    IsMatrixProjOnto (LinearMap.range (Matrix.toLin' P)) P
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun x => ⟨x, by simp⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  simp [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hP]

name: ProjectionConstants.re_trace_eq_sum
statement: lemma re_trace_eq_sum {P : Matrix ι ι 𝕜} : RCLike.re P.trace = ∑ i, RCLike.re (P i i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [Matrix.trace]

name: ProjectionConstants.sum_re_diag
statement:
lemma sum_re_diag {m : ℕ} {P : Matrix ι ι 𝕜} (hP : P ∈ orthProjs 𝕜 ι m) :
    ∑ i, RCLike.re (P i i) = m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← re_trace_eq_sum, hP.2]
  simp

name: ProjectionConstants.le_card_of_mem_orthProjs
statement:
lemma le_card_of_mem_orthProjs [DecidableEq ι] {m : ℕ} {P : Matrix ι ι 𝕜} (hP : P ∈ orthProjs 𝕜 ι m) :
    m ≤ Fintype.card ι
proof:
:= by
  rw [← finrank_range_of_mem_orthProjs hP]
  exact (Submodule.finrank_le _).trans (by simp)

name: ProjectionConstants.conjTranspose_mul_self_mem_orthProjs
statement:
lemma conjTranspose_mul_self_mem_orthProjs {m : ℕ} {U : Matrix (Fin m) ι 𝕜}
    (hU : U * Uᴴ = 1) : Uᴴ * U ∈ orthProjs 𝕜 ι m
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨by simp, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc U, hU, Matrix.one_mul]
  · rw [Matrix.trace_mul_comm, hU, Matrix.trace_one]
    simp

name: ProjectionConstants.injective_toLin'_conjTranspose
statement:
lemma injective_toLin'_conjTranspose {m : ℕ} {U : Matrix (Fin m) ι 𝕜} (hU : U * Uᴴ = 1) :
    Function.Injective (Matrix.toLin' Uᴴ)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  have := congrArg (fun z => U *ᵥ z) hxy
  simpa [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hU] using this

name: ProjectionConstants.finrank_range_toLin'_conjTranspose
statement:
lemma finrank_range_toLin'_conjTranspose {m : ℕ} {U : Matrix (Fin m) ι 𝕜} (hU : U * Uᴴ = 1) :
    Module.finrank 𝕜 (LinearMap.range (Matrix.toLin' Uᴴ)) = m
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj (injective_toLin'_conjTranspose hU)]
  simp

name: ProjectionConstants.exists_parseval_range
proof:
:= by
  let e : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 ι ≃ₗ[𝕜] (ι → 𝕜) := WithLp.linearEquiv 2 𝕜 (ι → 𝕜)
  let Y' : Submodule 𝕜 (EuclideanSpace 𝕜 ι) := Y.map e.symm.toLinearMap
  have hr' : Module.finrank 𝕜 Y' = r := by
    rw [← hr]
    exact LinearEquiv.finrank_map_eq e.symm Y
  let b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin r) 𝕜 Y' := (stdOrthonormalBasis 𝕜 Y').reindex (finCongr hr')
  let v : Fin r → (ι → 𝕜) := fun k => e (b k : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 ι)
  have hvY : ∀ k, v k ∈ Y := by
    intro k
    have hk : (b k : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 ι) ∈ Y' := (b k).2
    rw [Submodule.mem_map_equiv] at hk
    simpa [v] using hk
  let U : Matrix (Fin r) ι 𝕜 := Matrix.of fun k i => star (v k i)
  have hU : U * Uᴴ = 1 := by
    ext k l
    have hon := orthonormal_iff_ite.1 b.orthonormal k l
    rw [Submodule.coe_inner, EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct] at hon
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, U, Matrix.of_apply, star_star,
      Matrix.one_apply]
    rw [← hon]
    simp only [dotProduct, Pi.star_apply, v]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    simp [e, mul_comm]
  refine ⟨U, hU, ?_⟩
  have hle : LinearMap.range (Matrix.toLin' Uᴴ) ≤ Y := by
    rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
    have hz : Matrix.toLin' Uᴴ z = ∑ k, z k • v k := by
      ext i
      simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, U, Finset.sum_apply, mul_comm]
    rw [hz]
    exact Y.sum_mem fun k _ => Y.smul_mem _ (hvY k)
  refine Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq hle ?_
  rw [finrank_range_toLin'_conjTranspose hU, hr]

name: ProjectionConstants.range_toLin'_conjTranspose_mul_self
statement:
lemma range_toLin'_conjTranspose_mul_self {m : ℕ} {U : Matrix (Fin m) ι 𝕜} (hU : U * Uᴴ = 1) :
    LinearMap.range (Matrix.toLin' (Uᴴ * U)) = LinearMap.range (Matrix.toLin' Uᴴ)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨U *ᵥ z, by simp [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨Uᴴ *ᵥ z, ?_⟩
    simp only [Matrix.toLin'_apply, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hU, Matrix.mul_one]

name: ProjectionConstants.exists_mem_orthProjs_range
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hrange⟩ := exists_parseval_range Y hm
  exact ⟨Uᴴ * U, conjTranspose_mul_self_mem_orthProjs hU,
    (range_toLin'_conjTranspose_mul_self hU).trans hrange⟩

name: ProjectionConstants.exists_parseval_of_mem_orthProjs
statement:
theorem exists_parseval_of_mem_orthProjs {m : ℕ} {P : Matrix ι ι 𝕜}
    (hP : P ∈ orthProjs 𝕜 ι m) : ∃ U : Matrix (Fin m) ι 𝕜, U * Uᴴ = 1 ∧ Uᴴ * U = P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hrange⟩ := exists_parseval_range (LinearMap.range (Matrix.toLin' P))
    (finrank_range_of_mem_orthProjs hP)
  refine ⟨U, hU, ?_⟩
  
  have h1 : Uᴴ * U * P = P := by
    refine Matrix.toLin'.injective (LinearMap.ext fun z => ?_)
    have hz : P *ᵥ z ∈ LinearMap.range (Matrix.toLin' Uᴴ) := by
      rw [hrange]; exact ⟨z, by simp⟩
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hz
    simp only [Matrix.toLin'_apply] at hw ⊢
    rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← hw, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_assoc, hU,
      Matrix.mul_one]
  have h2 : P * (Uᴴ * U) = Uᴴ * U := by
    refine Matrix.toLin'.injective (LinearMap.ext fun z => ?_)
    have hz : (Uᴴ * U) *ᵥ z ∈ LinearMap.range (Matrix.toLin' P) := by
      rw [← hrange]; exact ⟨U *ᵥ z, by simp [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]⟩
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hz
    simp only [Matrix.toLin'_apply] at hw ⊢
    rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← hw, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hP.1.idem]
  have h3 : P * (Uᴴ * U) = P := by
    have := congrArg Matrix.conjTranspose h1
    simpa [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hP.1.herm, Matrix.mul_assoc] using this
  rw [← h2, h3]

name: ProjectionConstants.orthProjs_nonempty
statement:
theorem orthProjs_nonempty [DecidableEq ι] {m : ℕ} (hm : m ≤ Fintype.card ι) :
    (orthProjs 𝕜 ι m).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, -, hs⟩ := Finset.exists_subset_card_eq (s := (Finset.univ : Finset ι)) (by simpa)
  refine ⟨Matrix.diagonal fun i => if i ∈ s then 1 else 0, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply]
    split_ifs <;> simp_all [eq_comm]
  · rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    congr 1
    ext i
    split_ifs <;> simp
  · simp [Matrix.trace_diagonal, Finset.sum_ite_mem, hs]

name: ProjectionConstants.isCompact_orthProjs
statement: theorem isCompact_orthProjs (m : ℕ) : IsCompact (orthProjs 𝕜 ι m)
proof:
:= by
  let K : Set (Matrix ι ι 𝕜) :=
    Set.univ.pi fun _ : ι => Set.univ.pi fun _ : ι => Metric.closedBall (0 : 𝕜) 1
  have hK : IsCompact K :=
    isCompact_univ_pi fun _ => isCompact_univ_pi fun _ => isCompact_closedBall _ _
  refine hK.of_isClosed_subset ?_ ?_
  · have h1 : IsClosed {P : Matrix ι ι 𝕜 | Pᴴ = P} :=
      isClosed_eq continuous_id.matrix_conjTranspose continuous_id
    have h2 : IsClosed {P : Matrix ι ι 𝕜 | P * P = P} :=
      isClosed_eq (continuous_id.matrix_mul continuous_id) continuous_id
    have h3 : IsClosed {P : Matrix ι ι 𝕜 | P.trace = m} :=
      isClosed_eq continuous_id.matrix_trace continuous_const
    have : orthProjs 𝕜 ι m =
        ({P : Matrix ι ι 𝕜 | Pᴴ = P} ∩ {P | P * P = P}) ∩ {P | P.trace = m} := by
      ext P
      exact ⟨fun h => ⟨⟨h.1.herm, h.1.idem⟩, h.2⟩, fun h => ⟨⟨h.1.1, h.1.2⟩, h.2⟩⟩
    rw [this]
    exact (h1.inter h2).inter h3
  · intro P hP i _ j _
    exact Metric.mem_closedBall.2 (by simpa using hP.1.norm_apply_le_one i j)

name: ProjectionConstants.relProjConst_le_card
statement:
lemma relProjConst_le_card [DecidableEq ι] (Y : Submodule 𝕜 (ι → 𝕜)) :
    relProjConst Y ≤ Fintype.card ι
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP, hPY⟩ := exists_mem_orthProjs_range Y rfl
  have h := relProjConst_le_rowSumNorm Y (hPY ▸ isMatrixProjOnto_range hP.1.idem)
  refine h.trans (rowSumNorm_le (Nat.cast_nonneg _) fun i => ?_)
  calc ∑ j, ‖P i j‖ ≤ ∑ _j : ι, (1 : ℝ) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => hP.1.norm_apply_le_one i j
    _ = Fintype.card ι := by simp

name: ProjectionConstants.bddAbove_maxRelProjConst
statement:
lemma bddAbove_maxRelProjConst (m N : ℕ) :
    BddAbove (Set.range fun Y : {Y : Submodule 𝕜 (Fin N → 𝕜) // Module.finrank 𝕜 Y = m} =>
      relProjConst Y.1)
proof:
:=
  ⟨N, by rintro _ ⟨Y, rfl⟩; simpa using relProjConst_le_card Y.1⟩

name: ProjectionConstants.relProjConst_le_maxRelProjConst
statement:
lemma relProjConst_le_maxRelProjConst {m N : ℕ} (Y : Submodule 𝕜 (Fin N → 𝕜))
    (hY : Module.finrank 𝕜 Y = m) : relProjConst Y ≤ maxRelProjConst 𝕜 m N
proof:
:=
  le_ciSup (bddAbove_maxRelProjConst m N) ⟨Y, hY⟩

name: ProjectionConstants.maxRelProjConst_nonneg
statement: lemma maxRelProjConst_nonneg (m N : ℕ) : 0 ≤ maxRelProjConst 𝕜 m N
proof:
:=
  Real.iSup_nonneg fun Y => relProjConst_nonneg Y.1

name: ProjectionConstants.exists_isProjectionOnto
statement:
theorem exists_isProjectionOnto [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 Y] :
    ∃ P : X →L[𝕜] X, IsProjectionOnto Y P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := Submodule.ClosedComplemented.of_finiteDimensional Y
  refine ⟨Y.subtypeL.comp f, ⟨fun x => (f x).2, fun y hy => ?_⟩⟩
  simpa using congrArg Subtype.val (hf ⟨y, hy⟩)

name: ProjectionConstants.relProjConst_nonneg
statement: lemma relProjConst_nonneg : 0 ≤ relProjConst Y
proof:
:=
  Real.sInf_nonneg (by rintro _ ⟨P, -, rfl⟩; exact norm_nonneg _)

name: ProjectionConstants.relProjConst_le
statement: lemma relProjConst_le {P : X →L[𝕜] X} (hP : IsProjectionOnto Y P) : relProjConst Y ≤ ‖P‖
proof:
:=
  csInf_le ⟨0, by rintro _ ⟨Q, -, rfl⟩; exact norm_nonneg _⟩ ⟨P, hP, rfl⟩

name: ProjectionConstants.le_relProjConst
statement:
lemma le_relProjConst [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 Y] {c : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ P : X →L[𝕜] X, IsProjectionOnto Y P → c ≤ ‖P‖) : c ≤ relProjConst Y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := exists_isProjectionOnto Y
  exact le_csInf ⟨_, P, hP, rfl⟩ (by rintro _ ⟨Q, hQ, rfl⟩; exact h Q hQ)

name: ProjectionConstants.exists_isProjectionOnto_norm_lt
statement:
lemma exists_isProjectionOnto_norm_lt [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 Y] {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ P : X →L[𝕜] X, IsProjectionOnto Y P ∧ ‖P‖ < relProjConst Y + ε
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := exists_isProjectionOnto Y
  have hne : ((fun P : X →L[𝕜] X => ‖P‖) '' {P | IsProjectionOnto Y P}).Nonempty :=
    ⟨_, P, hP, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨Q, hQ, rfl⟩, h⟩ := exists_lt_of_csInf_lt hne
    (lt_add_of_pos_right (relProjConst Y) hε)
  exact ⟨Q, hQ, h⟩

name: ProjectionConstants.one_le_relProjConst
statement: lemma one_le_relProjConst [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 Y] (hY : Y ≠ ⊥) : 1 ≤ relProjConst Y
proof:
:= by
  refine le_relProjConst Y fun P hP => ?_
  obtain ⟨y, hyY, hy0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hY
  have h := P.le_opNorm y
  rw [hP.map_id y hyY] at h
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right (by simpa using h) (norm_pos_iff.2 hy0)

name: ProjectionConstants.Superspace.range_ofSubmodule
statement:
@[simp] lemma Superspace.range_ofSubmodule {X : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup X]
    [NormedSpace 𝕜 X] (Y : Submodule 𝕜 X) :
    LinearMap.range (Superspace.ofSubmodule Y).emb.toLinearMap = Y
proof:
:=
  Submodule.range_subtype Y

name: ProjectionConstants.relProjConst_le_of_maxRelProjConst_le
proof:
:= by
  have hL0 : 0 ≤ L := (maxRelProjConst_nonneg m 0).trans (hL 0)
  refine le_of_forall_pos_le_add fun δ hδ => ?_
  
  set ε : ℝ := min (1 / 2) (δ / (2 * (L + 1))) with hε_def
  have hε0 : 0 < ε := lt_min (by norm_num) (by positivity)
  have hε1 : ε ≤ 1 / 2 := min_le_left _ _
  have hε2 : ε * (2 * (L + 1)) ≤ δ := by
    have h := min_le_right (1 / 2 : ℝ) (δ / (2 * (L + 1)))
    rw [← hε_def] at h
    calc ε * (2 * (L + 1)) ≤ δ / (2 * (L + 1)) * (2 * (L + 1)) := by gcongr
      _ = δ := div_mul_cancel₀ _ (by positivity)
  
  have : ProperSpace (StrongDual 𝕜 Y) := FiniteDimensional.proper_rclike 𝕜 _
  obtain ⟨T, hTS, hTfin, hTcov⟩ := finite_cover_balls_of_compact
    (isCompact_sphere (0 : StrongDual 𝕜 Y) 1) hε0
  have : Fintype T := hTfin.fintype
  set N := Fintype.card T
  let e : Fin N ≃ T := (Fintype.equivFin T).symm
  let φ : Fin N → StrongDual 𝕜 Y := fun k => (e k).1
  have hφ1 : ∀ k, ‖φ k‖ = 1 := fun k => by simpa using hTS (e k).2
  have hφcov : ∀ ψ : StrongDual 𝕜 Y, ‖ψ‖ = 1 → ∃ k, ‖ψ - φ k‖ < ε := by
    intro ψ hψ
    have hψS : ψ ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : StrongDual 𝕜 Y) 1 := by simpa using hψ
    obtain ⟨χ, hχT, hχ⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 (hTcov hψS)
    refine ⟨e.symm ⟨χ, hχT⟩, ?_⟩
    simpa [φ, dist_eq_norm] using hχ
  
  let J : Y →L[𝕜] (Fin N → 𝕜) := ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun k => φ k
  have hJ_le : ∀ y, ‖J y‖ ≤ ‖y‖ := by
    intro y
    refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg y)).2 fun k => ?_
    calc ‖φ k y‖ ≤ ‖φ k‖ * ‖y‖ := (φ k).le_opNorm y
      _ = ‖y‖ := by rw [hφ1, one_mul]
  have hJ_ge : ∀ y, (1 - ε) * ‖y‖ ≤ ‖J y‖ := by
    intro y
    by_cases hy : y = 0
    · simp [hy]
    obtain ⟨ψ, hψ1, hψy⟩ := exists_dual_vector 𝕜 y (norm_ne_zero_iff.2 hy)
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hφcov ψ hψ1
    have h1 : ‖φ k y‖ ≤ ‖J y‖ := norm_le_pi_norm (J y) k
    have h2 : ‖(ψ - φ k) y‖ ≤ ε * ‖y‖ :=
      ((ψ - φ k).le_opNorm y).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hk.le (norm_nonneg y))
    have h3 : ‖ψ y‖ = ‖y‖ := by rw [hψy]; simp
    have h4 : ‖ψ y‖ ≤ ‖φ k y‖ + ‖(ψ - φ k) y‖ := by
      have hsub : (ψ - φ k) y = ψ y - φ k y := rfl
      rw [hsub]
      calc ‖ψ y‖ = ‖φ k y + (ψ y - φ k y)‖ := by rw [add_sub_cancel]
        _ ≤ _ := norm_add_le _ _
    nlinarith
  have hJinj : Function.Injective J := by
    intro y₁ y₂ h
    have h' : J (y₁ - y₂) = 0 := by rw [map_sub, h, sub_self]
    have := hJ_ge (y₁ - y₂)
    rw [h', norm_zero] at this
    have hpos : 0 < 1 - ε := by linarith
    have : ‖y₁ - y₂‖ ≤ 0 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg (y₁ - y₂)]
    exact sub_eq_zero.1 (norm_le_zero_iff.1 this)
  
  choose Φ hΦ hΦnorm using fun k => exists_extension_norm_eq Y (φ k)
  let Jt : X →L[𝕜] (Fin N → 𝕜) := ContinuousLinearMap.pi Φ
  have hJt_le : ∀ x, ‖Jt x‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := by
    intro x
    refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg x)).2 fun k => ?_
    calc ‖Φ k x‖ ≤ ‖Φ k‖ * ‖x‖ := (Φ k).le_opNorm x
      _ = ‖x‖ := by rw [hΦnorm, hφ1, one_mul]
  have hJt_Y : ∀ y : Y, Jt y = J y := by
    intro y
    ext k
    exact hΦ k y
  
  let Z : Submodule 𝕜 (Fin N → 𝕜) := LinearMap.range (J : Y →ₗ[𝕜] (Fin N → 𝕜))
  have hZ : Module.finrank 𝕜 Z = m := by
    rw [LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj hJinj, hY]
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQlt⟩ := exists_isProjectionOnto_norm_lt Z hε0
  have hQL : ‖Q‖ ≤ L + ε := by
    have := relProjConst_le_maxRelProjConst Z hZ
    linarith [hL N]
  
  let eJ : Y ≃ₗ[𝕜] Z := LinearEquiv.ofInjective (J : Y →ₗ[𝕜] (Fin N → 𝕜)) hJinj
  let Jinv : Z →L[𝕜] Y := LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap eJ.symm.toLinearMap
  have hJJinv : ∀ z : Z, J (Jinv z) = z := by
    intro z
    have h := LinearEquiv.ofInjective_apply (J : Y →ₗ[𝕜] (Fin N → 𝕜)) (h := hJinj) (eJ.symm z)
    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hJinv_le : ∀ z : Z, (1 - ε) * ‖Jinv z‖ ≤ ‖(z : Fin N → 𝕜)‖ := by
    intro z
    have := hJ_ge (Jinv z)
    rwa [hJJinv] at this
  have hJinvJ : ∀ y : Y, Jinv ⟨J y, ⟨y, rfl⟩⟩ = y := by
    intro y
    show eJ.symm _ = y
    rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
    ext1
    rw [LinearEquiv.ofInjective_apply]
    rfl
  
  let Qc : (Fin N → 𝕜) →L[𝕜] Z := Q.codRestrict Z hQ.mem
  let P : X →L[𝕜] X := Y.subtypeL.comp (Jinv.comp (Qc.comp Jt))
  have hP : IsProjectionOnto Y P := by
    refine ⟨fun x => (Jinv (Qc (Jt x))).2, fun y hy => ?_⟩
    have h1 : Jt y = J ⟨y, hy⟩ := hJt_Y ⟨y, hy⟩
    have h2 : Qc (Jt y) = ⟨J ⟨y, hy⟩, ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, rfl⟩⟩ := by
      ext1
      simp only [Qc, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_codRestrict_apply, h1]
      exact hQ.map_id _ ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, rfl⟩
    simp only [P, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.subtypeL_apply, h2, hJinvJ]
  have hpos : 0 < 1 - ε := by linarith
  have hPnorm : ‖P‖ ≤ (L + ε) / (1 - ε) := by
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (by positivity) fun x => ?_
    have h1 := hJinv_le (Qc (Jt x))
    have h2 : ‖((Qc (Jt x) : Z) : Fin N → 𝕜)‖ ≤ ‖Q‖ * ‖x‖ := by
      simp only [Qc, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_codRestrict_apply]
      exact (Q.le_opNorm _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hJt_le x) (norm_nonneg _))
    have h3 : ‖P x‖ = ‖Jinv (Qc (Jt x))‖ := by simp [P]
    rw [h3, div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ hpos]
    have := norm_nonneg x
    nlinarith
  calc relProjConst Y ≤ ‖P‖ := relProjConst_le Y hP
    _ ≤ (L + ε) / (1 - ε) := hPnorm
    _ ≤ L + δ := by
        rw [div_le_iff₀ hpos]
        nlinarith

name: ProjectionConstants.absProjConst_le_of_maxRelProjConst_le
statement:
theorem absProjConst_le_of_maxRelProjConst_le {m : ℕ} {L : ℝ}
    (hL : ∀ N, maxRelProjConst 𝕜 m N ≤ L) (Y : Type u) [NormedAddCommGroup Y]
    [NormedSpace 𝕜 Y] [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 Y] (hY : Module.finrank 𝕜 Y = m) :
    absProjConst 𝕜 Y ≤ L
proof:
:= by
  have hL0 : 0 ≤ L := (maxRelProjConst_nonneg m 0).trans (hL 0)
  refine Real.iSup_le (fun X => ?_) hL0
  have hinj : Function.Injective X.emb.toLinearMap := X.emb.injective
  have hfin : Module.finrank 𝕜 (LinearMap.range X.emb.toLinearMap) = m := by
    rw [LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj hinj, hY]
  exact relProjConst_le_of_maxRelProjConst_le hL _ hfin

name: ProjectionConstants.maxProjConst_le_of_maxRelProjConst_le
statement:
theorem maxProjConst_le_of_maxRelProjConst_le {m : ℕ} {L : ℝ}
    (hL : ∀ N, maxRelProjConst 𝕜 m N ≤ L) : maxProjConst 𝕜 m ≤ L
proof:
:= by
  have hL0 : 0 ≤ L := (maxRelProjConst_nonneg m 0).trans (hL 0)
  exact Real.iSup_le (fun Y => absProjConst_le_of_maxRelProjConst_le hL Y.carrier Y.finrank_eq) hL0

name: ProjectionConstants.relProjConst_le_absProjConst
proof:
:= by
  have hbdd : BddAbove (Set.range fun X' : Superspace 𝕜 Y =>
      relProjConst (LinearMap.range X'.emb.toLinearMap)) :=
    ⟨L, by
      rintro _ ⟨X', rfl⟩
      have hfin : Module.finrank 𝕜 (LinearMap.range X'.emb.toLinearMap) = m := by
        rw [LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj X'.emb.injective, hY]
      exact relProjConst_le_of_maxRelProjConst_le hL _ hfin⟩
  have h := le_ciSup hbdd (Superspace.ofSubmodule Y)
  rwa [Superspace.range_ofSubmodule] at h

name: ProjectionConstants.relProjConst_le_maxProjConst
proof:
:= by
  have hbdd : BddAbove (Set.range fun Y' : FinDimNormedSpace 𝕜 m => absProjConst 𝕜 Y'.carrier) :=
    ⟨L, by
      rintro _ ⟨Y', rfl⟩
      exact absProjConst_le_of_maxRelProjConst_le hL Y'.carrier Y'.finrank_eq⟩
  have h := le_ciSup hbdd ⟨Y, hY⟩
  exact (relProjConst_le_absProjConst hL Y hY).trans h

name: ProjectionConstants.absProjConst_nonneg
statement:
lemma absProjConst_nonneg (Y : Type u) [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [NormedSpace 𝕜 Y] :
    0 ≤ absProjConst 𝕜 Y
proof:
:=
  Real.iSup_nonneg fun _ => relProjConst_nonneg _

name: ProjectionConstants.maxProjConst_nonneg
statement: lemma maxProjConst_nonneg (m : ℕ) : 0 ≤ maxProjConst 𝕜 m
proof:
:=
  Real.iSup_nonneg fun Y => absProjConst_nonneg Y.carrier

name: ProjectionConstants.maxProjConst_eq_iSup
proof:
:= by
  have hbdd : BddAbove (Set.range fun N => maxRelProjConst 𝕜 m N) :=
    ⟨L, by rintro _ ⟨N, rfl⟩; exact hL N⟩
  refine le_antisymm (maxProjConst_le_of_maxRelProjConst_le fun N => le_ciSup hbdd N) ?_
  exact Real.iSup_le (fun N => Real.iSup_le (fun Y => relProjConst_le_maxProjConst hL Y.1 Y.2)
    (maxProjConst_nonneg m)) (maxProjConst_nonneg m)

name: ProjectionConstants.absSum_nonneg
statement: lemma absSum_nonneg (P : Matrix ι ι 𝕜) : 0 ≤ absSum P
proof:
:=
  sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sum_nonneg fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _

name: ProjectionConstants.weightedAbsSum_nonneg
statement:
lemma weightedAbsSum_nonneg {t : ι → ℝ} (ht : ∀ i, 0 ≤ t i) (P : Matrix ι ι 𝕜) :
    0 ≤ weightedAbsSum t P
proof:
:=
  sum_nonneg fun i _ => sum_nonneg fun j _ => by have := ht i; have := ht j; positivity

name: ProjectionConstants.sum_norm_sq_of_mem_orthProjs
statement:
lemma sum_norm_sq_of_mem_orthProjs {m : ℕ} {P : Matrix ι ι 𝕜} (hP : P ∈ orthProjs 𝕜 ι m) :
    ∑ i, ∑ j, ‖P i j‖ ^ 2 = m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sum_re_diag hP]
  exact sum_congr rfl fun i _ => (hP.1.re_diag_eq_sum_row i).symm

name: ProjectionConstants.weightedAbsSum_le_sqrt
statement:
theorem weightedAbsSum_le_sqrt {m : ℕ} {t : ι → ℝ} (ht : IsUnitWeight t) {P : Matrix ι ι 𝕜}
    (hP : P ∈ orthProjs 𝕜 ι m) : weightedAbsSum t P ≤ √m
proof:
:= by
  have hcs : (∑ ij : ι × ι, (t ij.1 * t ij.2) * ‖P ij.1 ij.2‖) ^ 2 ≤
      (∑ ij : ι × ι, (t ij.1 * t ij.2) ^ 2) * ∑ ij : ι × ι, ‖P ij.1 ij.2‖ ^ 2 :=
    sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq _ _ _
  have h1 : ∑ ij : ι × ι, (t ij.1 * t ij.2) ^ 2 = 1 := by
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    simp_rw [mul_pow, ← mul_sum, ← sum_mul, ht.sum_sq, one_mul]
  have h2 : ∑ ij : ι × ι, ‖P ij.1 ij.2‖ ^ 2 = m := by
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    exact sum_norm_sq_of_mem_orthProjs hP
  have h3 : weightedAbsSum t P = ∑ ij : ι × ι, (t ij.1 * t ij.2) * ‖P ij.1 ij.2‖ := by
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]; rfl
  rw [h1, h2, one_mul] at hcs
  rw [h3]
  exact Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le hcs

name: ProjectionConstants.isUnitWeight_uniform
statement:
lemma isUnitWeight_uniform [Nonempty ι] :
    IsUnitWeight (fun _ : ι => 1 / √(Fintype.card ι : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hN : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card ι := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  refine ⟨fun _ => by positivity, ?_⟩
  simp only [div_pow, one_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hN.le, sum_const, card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
  field_simp

name: ProjectionConstants.weightedAbsSum_uniform
statement:
lemma weightedAbsSum_uniform [Nonempty ι] (P : Matrix ι ι 𝕜) :
    weightedAbsSum (fun _ : ι => 1 / √(Fintype.card ι : ℝ)) P = absSum P / Fintype.card ι
proof:
:= by
  have hN : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card ι := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have h : 1 / √(Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * (1 / √(Fintype.card ι : ℝ)) = 1 / Fintype.card ι := by
    rw [div_mul_div_comm, one_mul, Real.mul_self_sqrt hN.le]
  unfold weightedAbsSum absSum
  simp only [Finset.sum_div]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun i _ => sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  rw [h]
  ring

name: ProjectionConstants.absSum_div_card_le_sqrt
statement:
theorem absSum_div_card_le_sqrt {m : ℕ} {P : Matrix ι ι 𝕜} (hP : P ∈ orthProjs 𝕜 ι m) :
    absSum P / Fintype.card ι ≤ √m
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι
  · simp
  · rw [← weightedAbsSum_uniform]
    exact weightedAbsSum_le_sqrt isUnitWeight_uniform hP

name: ProjectionConstants.bddAbove_clConst_set
statement:
lemma bddAbove_clConst_set :
    BddAbove {x | ∃ t P, IsUnitWeight t ∧ P ∈ orthProjs 𝕜 ι m ∧ x = weightedAbsSum t P}
proof:
:=
  ⟨√m, by rintro _ ⟨t, P, ht, hP, rfl⟩; exact weightedAbsSum_le_sqrt ht hP⟩

name: ProjectionConstants.bddAbove_quasiRelConst_set
statement:
lemma bddAbove_quasiRelConst_set :
    BddAbove {x | ∃ P ∈ orthProjs 𝕜 ι m, x = absSum P / Fintype.card ι}
proof:
:=
  ⟨√m, by rintro _ ⟨P, hP, rfl⟩; exact absSum_div_card_le_sqrt hP⟩

name: ProjectionConstants.le_clConst
statement:
lemma le_clConst {t : ι → ℝ} (ht : IsUnitWeight t) {P : Matrix ι ι 𝕜}
    (hP : P ∈ orthProjs 𝕜 ι m) : weightedAbsSum t P ≤ clConst 𝕜 ι m
proof:
:=
  le_csSup bddAbove_clConst_set ⟨t, P, ht, hP, rfl⟩

name: ProjectionConstants.clConst_le_sqrt
statement: lemma clConst_le_sqrt : clConst 𝕜 ι m ≤ √m
proof:
:=
  Real.sSup_le (by rintro _ ⟨t, P, ht, hP, rfl⟩; exact weightedAbsSum_le_sqrt ht hP)
    (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)

name: ProjectionConstants.clConst_nonneg
statement: lemma clConst_nonneg : 0 ≤ clConst 𝕜 ι m
proof:
:=
  Real.sSup_nonneg (by rintro _ ⟨t, P, ht, hP, rfl⟩; exact weightedAbsSum_nonneg ht.nonneg P)

name: ProjectionConstants.clConst_le
statement:
lemma clConst_le {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (h : ∀ t P, IsUnitWeight t → P ∈ orthProjs 𝕜 ι m → weightedAbsSum t P ≤ c) :
    clConst 𝕜 ι m ≤ c
proof:
:=
  Real.sSup_le (by rintro _ ⟨t, P, ht, hP, rfl⟩; exact h t P ht hP) hc

name: ProjectionConstants.le_quasiRelConst
statement:
lemma le_quasiRelConst {P : Matrix ι ι 𝕜} (hP : P ∈ orthProjs 𝕜 ι m) :
    absSum P / Fintype.card ι ≤ quasiRelConst 𝕜 ι m
proof:
:=
  le_csSup bddAbove_quasiRelConst_set ⟨P, hP, rfl⟩

name: ProjectionConstants.quasiRelConst_le_sqrt
statement: lemma quasiRelConst_le_sqrt : quasiRelConst 𝕜 ι m ≤ √m
proof:
:=
  Real.sSup_le (by rintro _ ⟨P, hP, rfl⟩; exact absSum_div_card_le_sqrt hP) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)

name: ProjectionConstants.quasiRelConst_nonneg
statement: lemma quasiRelConst_nonneg : 0 ≤ quasiRelConst 𝕜 ι m
proof:
:=
  Real.sSup_nonneg (by rintro _ ⟨P, -, rfl⟩; exact div_nonneg (absSum_nonneg P) (by positivity))

name: ProjectionConstants.quasiRelConst_le
statement:
lemma quasiRelConst_le {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (h : ∀ P ∈ orthProjs 𝕜 ι m, absSum P / Fintype.card ι ≤ c) : quasiRelConst 𝕜 ι m ≤ c
proof:
:=
  Real.sSup_le (by rintro _ ⟨P, hP, rfl⟩; exact h P hP) hc

name: ProjectionConstants.quasiRelConst_le_clConst
statement: lemma quasiRelConst_le_clConst : quasiRelConst 𝕜 ι m ≤ clConst 𝕜 ι m
proof:
:= by
  refine quasiRelConst_le clConst_nonneg fun P hP => ?_
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι
  · simp [absSum, clConst_nonneg]
  · rw [← weightedAbsSum_uniform]
    exact le_clConst isUnitWeight_uniform hP

name: ProjectionConstants.bddAbove_range_quasiRelConst
statement: lemma bddAbove_range_quasiRelConst : BddAbove (Set.range fun N : ℕ => quasiRelConst 𝕜 (Fin N) m)
proof:
:=
  ⟨√m, by rintro _ ⟨N, rfl⟩; exact quasiRelConst_le_sqrt⟩

name: ProjectionConstants.quasiRelConst_le_quasiMaxConst
statement: lemma quasiRelConst_le_quasiMaxConst (N : ℕ) : quasiRelConst 𝕜 (Fin N) m ≤ quasiMaxConst 𝕜 m
proof:
:=
  le_ciSup bddAbove_range_quasiRelConst N

name: ProjectionConstants.quasiMaxConst_le_sqrt
statement: lemma quasiMaxConst_le_sqrt : quasiMaxConst 𝕜 m ≤ √m
proof:
:=
  Real.iSup_le (fun _ => quasiRelConst_le_sqrt) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)

name: ProjectionConstants.quasiMaxConst_nonneg
statement: lemma quasiMaxConst_nonneg : 0 ≤ quasiMaxConst 𝕜 m
proof:
:=
  Real.iSup_nonneg fun _ => quasiRelConst_nonneg

name: ProjectionConstants.quasiMaxConst_le
statement:
lemma quasiMaxConst_le {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (h : ∀ N, quasiRelConst 𝕜 (Fin N) m ≤ c) :
    quasiMaxConst 𝕜 m ≤ c
proof:
:=
  Real.iSup_le h hc

name: ProjectionConstants.submatrix_mem_orthProjs
statement:
lemma submatrix_mem_orthProjs {m : ℕ} (e : κ ≃ ι) {P : Matrix ι ι 𝕜}
    (hP : P ∈ orthProjs 𝕜 ι m) : P.submatrix e e ∈ orthProjs 𝕜 κ m
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_submatrix, hP.1.herm]
  · rw [Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv, hP.1.idem]
  · rw [← hP.2]
    simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply]
    exact Equiv.sum_comp e (fun x => P x x)

name: ProjectionConstants.absSum_submatrix
statement: lemma absSum_submatrix (e : κ ≃ ι) (P : Matrix ι ι 𝕜) : absSum (P.submatrix e e) = absSum P
proof:
:= by
  simp only [absSum, Matrix.submatrix_apply]
  rw [Equiv.sum_comp e (fun i => ∑ j, ‖P i (e j)‖)]
  exact sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Equiv.sum_comp e (fun j => ‖P i j‖)

name: ProjectionConstants.quasiRelConst_le_of_equiv
statement:
lemma quasiRelConst_le_of_equiv {m : ℕ} (e : κ ≃ ι) :
    quasiRelConst 𝕜 ι m ≤ quasiRelConst 𝕜 κ m
proof:
:= by
  refine quasiRelConst_le quasiRelConst_nonneg fun P hP => ?_
  have h := le_quasiRelConst (submatrix_mem_orthProjs e hP)
  rwa [absSum_submatrix, Fintype.card_congr e] at h

name: ProjectionConstants.quasiRelConst_congr
statement: lemma quasiRelConst_congr {m : ℕ} (e : κ ≃ ι) : quasiRelConst 𝕜 κ m = quasiRelConst 𝕜 ι m
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (quasiRelConst_le_of_equiv e.symm) (quasiRelConst_le_of_equiv e)

name: ProjectionConstants.quasiRelConst_le_quasiMaxConst'
statement: lemma quasiRelConst_le_quasiMaxConst' {m : ℕ} : quasiRelConst 𝕜 ι m ≤ quasiMaxConst 𝕜 m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← quasiRelConst_congr (Fintype.equivFin ι).symm]
  exact quasiRelConst_le_quasiMaxConst _

name: ProjectionConstants.quasiRelConst_eq_sSup_parseval
proof:
:= by
  unfold quasiRelConst
  congr 1
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨P, hP, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨U, hU, rfl⟩ := exists_parseval_of_mem_orthProjs hP
    exact ⟨U, hU, by rw [absSum, one_div_mul_eq_div]⟩
  · rintro ⟨U, hU, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, conjTranspose_mul_self_mem_orthProjs hU, by rw [absSum, one_div_mul_eq_div]⟩

name: ProjectionConstants.clConst_eq_sSup_parseval
proof:
:= by
  unfold clConst
  congr 1
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, P, ht, hP, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨U, hU, rfl⟩ := exists_parseval_of_mem_orthProjs hP
    exact ⟨t, U, ht.nonneg, ht.sum_sq, hU, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨t, U, ht0, ht1, hU, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨t, _, ⟨ht0, ht1⟩, conjTranspose_mul_self_mem_orthProjs hU, rfl⟩

name: ProjectionConstants.maxRelProjConst_eq_clConst
statement: theorem maxRelProjConst_eq_clConst (m N : ℕ) : maxRelProjConst 𝕜 m N = clConst 𝕜 (Fin N) m
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (Real.iSup_le (fun Y => relProjConst_le_clConst Y.1 Y.2) clConst_nonneg)
    (clConst_le_maxRelProjConst m N)

name: ProjectionConstants.maxRelProjConst_eq_sSup_parseval
statement:
theorem maxRelProjConst_eq_sSup_parseval (m N : ℕ) :
    maxRelProjConst 𝕜 m N = sSup {x | ∃ (t : Fin N → ℝ) (U : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin N) 𝕜),
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ t i) ∧ ∑ i, t i ^ 2 = 1 ∧ U * Uᴴ = 1 ∧
        x = ∑ i, ∑ j, t i * t j * ‖(Uᴴ * U) i j‖}
proof:
:= by
  rw [maxRelProjConst_eq_clConst, clConst_eq_sSup_parseval]

name: ProjectionConstants.maxRelProjConst_le_sqrt
statement: lemma maxRelProjConst_le_sqrt (m N : ℕ) : maxRelProjConst 𝕜 m N ≤ √m
proof:
:= by
  rw [maxRelProjConst_eq_clConst]; exact clConst_le_sqrt

name: ProjectionConstants.quasiRelConst_le_maxRelProjConst
statement:
lemma quasiRelConst_le_maxRelProjConst (m N : ℕ) :
    quasiRelConst 𝕜 (Fin N) m ≤ maxRelProjConst 𝕜 m N
proof:
:= by
  rw [maxRelProjConst_eq_clConst]; exact quasiRelConst_le_clConst

name: ProjectionConstants.isCompact_unitWeights
statement: lemma isCompact_unitWeights : IsCompact (unitWeights ι)
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : unitWeights ι ⊆ Set.univ.pi fun _ : ι => Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    intro t ht i _
    refine ⟨ht.nonneg i, ?_⟩
    have h := single_le_sum (f := fun i => t i ^ 2) (fun j _ => sq_nonneg (t j)) (mem_univ i)
    rw [ht.sum_sq] at h
    nlinarith [ht.nonneg i]
  refine (isCompact_univ_pi fun _ => isCompact_Icc).of_isClosed_subset ?_ hsub
  have h1 : IsClosed {t : ι → ℝ | ∀ i, 0 ≤ t i} := by
    simp only [Set.ofPred_forall]
    exact isClosed_iInter fun i => isClosed_le continuous_const (continuous_apply i)
  have h2 : IsClosed {t : ι → ℝ | ∑ i, t i ^ 2 = 1} :=
    isClosed_eq (continuous_finsetSum _ fun i _ => (continuous_apply i).pow 2) continuous_const
  have : unitWeights ι = {t : ι → ℝ | ∀ i, 0 ≤ t i} ∩ {t | ∑ i, t i ^ 2 = 1} := by
    ext t; exact ⟨fun h => ⟨h.1, h.2⟩, fun h => ⟨h.1, h.2⟩⟩
  rw [this]
  exact h1.inter h2

name: ProjectionConstants.exists_clConst_eq
statement:
theorem exists_clConst_eq {m : ℕ} (hm : m ≤ Fintype.card ι) [Nonempty ι] :
    ∃ t P, IsUnitWeight t ∧ P ∈ orthProjs 𝕜 ι m ∧ weightedAbsSum t P = clConst 𝕜 ι m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P₀, hP₀⟩ := orthProjs_nonempty (𝕜 := 𝕜) hm
  have hK : IsCompact (unitWeights ι ×ˢ orthProjs 𝕜 ι m) :=
    isCompact_unitWeights.prod (isCompact_orthProjs m)
  have hcont : Continuous fun p : (ι → ℝ) × Matrix ι ι 𝕜 => weightedAbsSum p.1 p.2 :=
    continuous_finsetSum _ fun i _ => continuous_finsetSum _ fun j _ =>
      (((continuous_apply i).comp continuous_fst).mul ((continuous_apply j).comp continuous_fst)).mul
        ((continuous_apply_apply i j).comp continuous_snd).norm
  obtain ⟨⟨t, P⟩, ⟨ht, hP⟩, hmax⟩ := hK.exists_isMaxOn
    ⟨(_, P₀), isUnitWeight_uniform, hP₀⟩ hcont.continuousOn
  refine ⟨t, P, ht, hP, le_antisymm (le_clConst ht hP) (clConst_le ?_ fun t' P' ht' hP' => ?_)⟩
  · exact weightedAbsSum_nonneg ht.nonneg P
  · exact hmax (Set.mk_mem_prod ht' hP')

name: ProjectionConstants.exists_quasiRelConst_eq
statement:
theorem exists_quasiRelConst_eq {m : ℕ} (hm : m ≤ Fintype.card ι) :
    ∃ P ∈ orthProjs 𝕜 ι m, absSum P / Fintype.card ι = quasiRelConst 𝕜 ι m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P₀, hP₀⟩ := orthProjs_nonempty (𝕜 := 𝕜) hm
  have hcont : Continuous fun P : Matrix ι ι 𝕜 => absSum P / Fintype.card ι :=
    (continuous_finsetSum _ fun i _ => continuous_finsetSum _ fun j _ =>
      (continuous_apply_apply i j).norm).div_const _
  obtain ⟨P, hP, hmax⟩ := (isCompact_orthProjs m).exists_isMaxOn ⟨P₀, hP₀⟩ hcont.continuousOn
  exact ⟨P, hP, le_antisymm (le_quasiRelConst hP)
    (quasiRelConst_le (div_nonneg (absSum_nonneg P) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)) fun P' hP' => hmax hP')⟩

name: ProjectionConstants.norm_rsgn_le
statement: lemma norm_rsgn_le (z : 𝕜) : ‖rsgn z‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [rsgn, norm_mul, RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_inv, abs_norm]
  by_cases hz : z = 0
  · simp [hz]
  · rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ (norm_ne_zero_iff.2 hz)]

name: ProjectionConstants.rsgn_mul_conj
statement: lemma rsgn_mul_conj (z : 𝕜) : rsgn z * star z = (‖z‖ : 𝕜)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rsgn, mul_assoc, RCLike.star_def, RCLike.mul_conj]
  by_cases hz : z = 0
  · simp [hz]
  · have : ‖z‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.2 hz
    push_cast
    field_simp

name: ProjectionConstants.star_rsgn
statement: lemma star_rsgn (z : 𝕜) : star (rsgn z) = rsgn (star z)
proof:
:= by
  simp [rsgn, RCLike.star_def]

name: ProjectionConstants.apply_eq_star_of_herm
statement:
lemma apply_eq_star_of_herm {P : Matrix ι ι 𝕜} (hP : Pᴴ = P) (i j : ι) :
    P j i = star (P i j)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← hP]
  rfl

name: ProjectionConstants.sgnMat_conjTranspose
statement: lemma sgnMat_conjTranspose {P : Matrix ι ι 𝕜} (hP : Pᴴ = P) : (sgnMat P)ᴴ = sgnMat P
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [sgnMat, conjTranspose_apply, of_apply, star_rsgn]
  rw [← apply_eq_star_of_herm hP]

name: ProjectionConstants.norm_sgnMat_le
statement: lemma norm_sgnMat_le (P : Matrix ι ι 𝕜) (i j : ι) : ‖sgnMat P i j‖ ≤ 1
proof: := norm_rsgn_le _

name: ProjectionConstants.re_trace_le_relProjConst
statement:
theorem re_trace_le_relProjConst {P₀ A : Matrix ι ι 𝕜} (hP₀ : P₀ * P₀ = P₀)
    (hAP : A * P₀ = P₀ * A) {α : ι → ℝ} (hα : ∀ i j, ‖A j i‖ ≤ α i) (hsum : ∑ i, α i ≤ 1) :
    RCLike.re (A * P₀).trace ≤ relProjConst (LinearMap.range (Matrix.toLin' P₀))
proof:
:= by
  refine le_relProjConst_of_rowSumNorm _ fun R hR => ?_
  have hRP : R * P₀ = P₀ := by
    refine Matrix.toLin'.injective (LinearMap.ext fun v => ?_)
    simp only [Matrix.toLin'_apply, ← mulVec_mulVec]
    exact hR.map_id _ ⟨v, rfl⟩
  have hPR : P₀ * R = R := by
    refine Matrix.toLin'.injective (LinearMap.ext fun v => ?_)
    simp only [Matrix.toLin'_apply]
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hR.mem v
    rw [Matrix.toLin'_apply] at hw
    rw [← mulVec_mulVec, ← hw, mulVec_mulVec, hP₀]
  have htr : (A * P₀).trace = (A * R).trace := by
    calc (A * P₀).trace = (A * R * P₀).trace := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hRP]
      _ = (P₀ * (A * R)).trace := by rw [Matrix.trace_mul_comm]
      _ = (A * P₀ * R).trace := by rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← hAP]
      _ = (A * R).trace := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hPR]
  have hα0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ α i := fun i => (norm_nonneg _).trans (hα i i)
  rw [htr]
  calc RCLike.re (A * R).trace ≤ ‖(A * R).trace‖ := RCLike.re_le_norm _
    _ = ‖∑ j, ∑ i, A j i * R i j‖ := by simp [Matrix.trace, Matrix.mul_apply]
    _ ≤ ∑ j, ∑ i, ‖A j i‖ * ‖R i j‖ := by
        refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (sum_le_sum fun j _ => ?_)
        refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
        simp
    _ = ∑ i, ∑ j, ‖A j i‖ * ‖R i j‖ := Finset.sum_comm
    _ ≤ ∑ i, α i * ∑ j, ‖R i j‖ := by
        refine sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
        rw [mul_sum]
        exact sum_le_sum fun j _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hα i j) (norm_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ ∑ i, α i * rowSumNorm R :=
        sum_le_sum fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (row_le_rowSumNorm R i) (hα0 i)
    _ = (∑ i, α i) * rowSumNorm R := by rw [sum_mul]
    _ ≤ 1 * rowSumNorm R := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsum (rowSumNorm_nonneg R)
    _ = rowSumNorm R := one_mul _

name: ProjectionConstants.continuous_weightedAbsSum
statement:
lemma continuous_weightedAbsSum (t : ι → ℝ) :
    Continuous fun P : Matrix ι ι 𝕜 => weightedAbsSum t P
proof:
:=
  continuous_finsetSum _ fun i _ => continuous_finsetSum _ fun j _ =>
    continuous_const.mul (continuous_apply_apply i j).norm

name: ProjectionConstants.trace_mul_eq_sum
statement: lemma trace_mul_eq_sum (B Q : Matrix ι ι 𝕜) : (B * Q).trace = ∑ i, ∑ j, B i j * Q j i
proof:
:= by
  simp [Matrix.trace, Matrix.mul_apply]

name: ProjectionConstants.diag_mul_mul_diag_apply
statement:
